description: 包含職缺公告，面試流程與聘僱合約相關詞彙

words.example_en: Applicants are required to submit an updated resume along with three professional references.
words.example_zh: 應徵者須提交最新版本的履歷表以及三份專業推薦人資料。
collocations: tailor a resume（量身打造履歷）

words.example_en: The HR department announced an opening for a senior data analyst.
words.example_zh: 人力資源部宣布了一個高級數據分析師的職缺。

words.example_en: All qualified applicants will be invited for an online interview next week.
words.example_zh: 所有符合資格的應徵者將獲邀參加下週的線上面試。
collocations: applicant tracking system（應徵者追蹤系統）

words.example_en: Fluency in English is a mandatory requirement for this international sales position.
words.example_zh: 流利的英文能力是這個國際業務職缺的必要條件。

words.example_en: The candidate has failed to meet the basic qualifications for the post.
words.example_zh: 該候選人未能達到該職位要求的基本資格。

words.example_en: She is highly qualified to manage the new marketing project.
words.example_zh: 她非常有資格來管理這個新的行銷專案。
collocations: highly qualified（非常資深的/合適的）

words.example_en: We will interview the top three candidates for the branch manager position tomorrow.
words.example_zh: 我們明天將面試分行經理職位的 前三名候選人。

words.example_en: The board expressed full confidence in the CEO's expansion strategy.
words.example_zh: 董事會對執行長的擴張策略表達了充分的信心。

words.example_en: The new software update is highly recommended by technical experts.
words.example_zh: 這款新軟體更新獲得了技術專家的高度推薦。

words.example_en: All team members are expected to maintain a professional attitude at work.
words.example_zh: 所有團隊成員都被期待在工作場合保持專業的態度。

words.example_en: The hiring manager will conduct a second-round interview on Thursday.
words.example_zh: 招募經理將於星期四主持第二輪面試。

words.example_en: The company plans to hire ten new engineers to speed up software development.
words.example_zh: 該公司計劃僱用十名新工程師以加速軟體開發。
collocations: hire temporary staff（僱用臨時員工）

words.example_en: New employees must complete a mandatory two-week training program.
words.example_zh: 新員工必須完成為期兩週的強制性培訓課程。

words.example_en: Please include the contact details of two former supervisors as your references.
words.example_zh: 請附上兩位前任主管的聯絡方式作為您的推薦人。

words.example_en: She was recently promoted to a management position within the sales division.
words.example_zh: 她最近升任為銷售部門的管理職位。
collocations: apply for a position（應徵職位）

words.example_en: Completing the complex project ahead of schedule was a major achievement for the team.
words.example_zh: 提前完成這個複雜的專案是該團隊的一項重大成就。

words.example_en: The interview panel was favorably impressed by the candidate's presentation.
words.example_zh: 面試小組對該應徵者的簡報印象非常深刻。

words.example_en: The candidate has an excellent track record in increasing annual sales.
words.example_zh: 該候選人在提升年度銷售額方面擁有優秀的過往紀錄。
collocations: excellent communication skills（優秀的溝通技巧）

words.example_en: Employees who complete one year of service are eligible for annual bonuses.
words.example_zh: 服務滿一年的員工有資格獲得年度獎金。
collocations: be eligible to do（有資格去做……）

words.example_en: The audit team was able to identify several areas for cost reduction.
words.example_zh: 審計團隊能夠找出幾個可以降低成本的領域。
collocations: identify potential risks（識別潛在風險）

words.definition: 使有關聯 / 同事 / 副的
words.example_en: Many people associate high prices with superior quality.
words.example_zh: 許多人會將高價格與優良品質聯繫在一起。

words.example_en: Working under safe and fair conditions is a fundamental right for all staff.
words.example_zh: 在安全且公平的條件下工作是所有員工的基本權利。

words.example_en: The government released new statistics showing a steady increase in full-time employment.
words.example_zh: 政府公布了最新的統計數據，顯示全職就業人口穩定增長。
collocations: termination of employment（解僱/終止僱用）

words.example_en: The project was delayed due to a total lack of technical resources.
words.example_zh: 該專案因完全缺乏技術資源而延誤。

words.example_en: Applicants should have at least five years of managerial experience in retail.
words.example_zh: 應徵者應具備至少五年零售業的管理經驗。

words.example_en: Through diligent research, the team was able to solve the technical issue.
words.example_zh: 透過勤奮的研究，團隊成功解決了該項技術難題。

words.example_en: New staff should become familiar with the safety procedures as soon as possible.
words.example_zh: 新員工應儘快熟悉安全操作程序。

words.example_en: Candidates must demonstrate proficiency in both English and Mandarin.
words.example_zh: 應徵者必須展現精通英文與中文的能力。

words.example_en: The company sent promotional brochures to prospective clients across the region.
words.example_zh: 該公司向該地區的潛在客戶寄送了宣傳手冊。

words.definition: 呼籲；有吸引力 / 吸引力
words.example_en: The flexible work policy really appeals to younger job seekers.
words.example_zh: 彈性的工作政策對年輕求職者非常有吸引力。
collocations: appeal to（對……有吸引力；向……呼籲）

words.example_en: Our agency specializes in recruiting high-level tech executives.
words.example_zh: 我們的機構專攻於招募高階科技主管。

words.example_en: Many employees felt apprehensive about the upcoming company restructuring.
words.example_zh: 許多員工對即將到來的公司重組感到不安。

words.example_en: We hired a financial consultant to optimize our operational expenses.
words.example_zh: 我們聘請了一位財務顧問來優化我們的營運支出。
collocations: act as a consultant（擔任顧問）

words.example_en: This pass entitles the holder to free entry for all workshops.
words.example_zh: 這張通行證賦予持有人免費參加所有研討會的權利。
collocations: be entitled to do（有權去做……）

words.example_en: Applicants must hold a bachelor's degree in business administration.
words.example_zh: 應徵者必須擁有企業管理學士學位。
collocations: to a certain degree（在某種程度上）

words.example_en: The finance department is responsible for processing the monthly payroll.
words.example_zh: 財務部負責處理每月的發薪事宜。
collocations: on the payroll（列入發薪名單；在職）

words.definition: 招募（新進人員） / 新進人員
words.example_en: The HR team travels to major universities every spring to recruit top talent.
words.example_zh: 人資團隊每年春天都會前往各大大學招募優秀人才。

words.example_en: Obtaining a project management certification can boost your career prospects.
words.example_zh: 獲得專案管理認證可以提升你的職涯前景。

words.example_en: Please state your name, age, and occupation on the form.
words.example_zh: 請在表格上註明您的姓名、年齡與職業。

words.definition: 工資，薪水（通常指按小時或每週計算者）
words.example_en: The government has decided to raise the minimum hourly wage starting next month.
words.example_zh: 政府決定從下個月開始調升每小時最低工資。

words.example_en: Please fill out the application form carefully before submitting it.
words.example_zh: 請在提交前仔細填寫申請書。
collocations: fill out an application form（填寫申請書）

words.example_en: She built a successful career in international marketing over the last decade.
words.example_zh: 在過去十年裡，她在國際行銷領域建立了成功的職業生涯。

words.example_en: Upon completion of the training course, participants will receive a certificate.
words.example_zh: 培訓課程結束後，參訓者將獲得證書。

words.example_en: The manager treats all team members with fair and equal standards.
words.example_zh: 經理以公平且平等的標準對待所有團隊成員。
collocations: fair market value（公平市場價值）

words.example_en: He joined the IT company shortly after his graduation from university.
words.example_zh: 他大學畢業後不久就加入了那家 IT 公司。

words.example_en: In fact, our quarter sales figures exceeded all expectations.
words.example_zh: 事實上，我們本季的銷售數據超過了所有預期。

words.example_en: Many university graduates attended the annual job fair to seek opportunities.
words.example_zh: 許多大學畢業生參加了年度就業博覽會以尋找機會。
collocations: annual job fair（年度就業博覽會）
attend a job fair（參加就業博覽會）

words.example_en: She decided to accept the job offer from the multinational corporation.
words.example_zh: 她決定接受該跨國公司的工作邀約。
collocations: accept a job offer（接受工作邀約）
extend a job offer（提供工作邀約）

words.example_en: Please check the list of shortlisted candidates posted on the bulletin board.
words.example_zh: 請確認貼在公告欄上的入圍候選人名單。

words.example_en: The HR department organized a welcoming lunch for the newcomers.
words.example_zh: 人力資源部為新進成員組織了一次歡迎午餐。

words.example_en: The store is hiring part-time assistants for the holiday season.
words.example_zh: 該商店正在為假期季節招聘兼職助理。

words.example_en: His previous job provided him with valuable experience in customer service.
words.example_zh: 他的上一份工作為他提供了寶貴的客戶服務經驗。
collocations: leave a previous job（離開上一份工作）

words.example_en: The executive secretary scheduled the regional conference for next Monday.
words.example_zh: 執行秘書安排了下週一的區域會議。

words.example_en: Interested applicants should send in their resumes before the deadline.
words.example_zh: 有興趣的應徵者應在截止日期前遞交履歷。
collocations: send in an application（遞交申請）

words.example_en: Employees are required to keep their workstations clean and tidy.
words.example_zh: 員工被要求保持工作站乾淨整潔。

words.example_en: The management trainee completed rotations in three different departments.
words.example_zh: 管理受訓者完成了三個不同部門的輪調。
collocations: management trainee（儲備幹部/管理受訓生）

words.example_en: He decided to apply for the position of senior graphic designer.
words.example_zh: 他決定申請高級平面設計師的職位。
collocations: apply for a job（申請工作）
apply for a visa（申請簽證）

words.example_en: The test measures an applicant's technical aptitude and problem-solving skills.
words.example_zh: 該測試旨在衡量應徵者的技術才能和解決問題能力。
collocations: aptitude test（性向測驗/能力測驗）
show an aptitude for（展現……的天賦）

words.example_en: Only authorized personnel are admitted to the server room.
words.example_zh: 只有授權人員被允許進入伺服器機房。
collocations: be admitted to the program（被該計畫錄取）

words.example_en: Passengers are advised to arrive at the airport two hours prior to departure.
words.example_zh: 建議乘客在起飛前兩小時到達機場。

words.example_en: The selection criteria for the fellowship program are extremely strict.
words.example_zh: 獎學金計畫的篩選標準極為嚴格。

words.example_en: The company has maintained strong profitability for over a decade.
words.example_zh: 該公司十年多來一直保持著強勁的盈利能力。

words.example_en: The factory employs over five hundred local workers.
words.example_zh: 這家工廠僱用了五百多名當地工人。

words.example_en: The proposal was rejected due to insufficient budget allocation.
words.example_zh: 該提案因預算分配不足而被否定。

words.example_en: Applicants must possess a minimum of three years of industry experience.
words.example_zh: 應徵者必須擁有最少三年的行業經驗。

words.example_en: Both parties agreed to the terms stated in the employment contract.
words.example_zh: 雙方皆同意僱用合約中所載明的條款。

words.example_en: There are plentiful job opportunities in the tech sector this year.
words.example_zh: 今年科技領域有充足的就業機會。

words.example_en: Choosing a profession in medical research requires years of dedication.
words.example_zh: 選擇醫學研究作為職業需要多年的投入。

words.example_en: Through hard work, she managed to achieve her goal of becoming a project director.
words.example_zh: 透過努力工作，她成功達到了成為專案總監的目標。

words.example_en: He joined the engineering firm as an apprentice.
words.example_zh: 他作為一名學徒加入了這家工程公司。

words.example_en: All employees attending the gala are required to dress formally.
words.example_zh: 所有參加晚宴的員工都必須穿著正式。
collocations: dress formally for an interview（面試時穿著正式）

words.example_en: The candidates dressed in suits waited nervously in the lobby.
words.example_zh: 穿著西裝的候選人在大廳裡緊張地等待。
collocations: sharply dressed in a suit（穿著十分挺拔的西裝）

words.example_en: We need to figure out a solution to the supply chain bottleneck.
words.example_zh: 我們需要想出解決供應鏈瓶頸的方法。
collocations: figure out a problem（解決問題）

words.example_en: She transitioned from freelance consulting to full time work.
words.example_zh: 她從自由顧問轉為了全職工作。
collocations: seek full time work（尋求全職工作）

words.example_en: The rapid growth of AI created many new job opportunities.
words.example_zh: 人工智慧的快速發展創造了許多新的工作機會。
collocations: abundant job opportunities（豐富的工作機會）

words.example_en: Online recruitment platforms can simplify your job search process.
words.example_zh: 線上招募平台可以簡化你的求職流程。

words.example_en: The career center provides free counseling for job seekers.
words.example_zh: 職涯中心為求職者提供免費諮詢。

words.example_en: The manager laid out the new strategic plan during the meeting.
words.example_zh: 經理在會議期間展示了新的戰略計劃。

words.example_en: Her professor wrote a strong letter of recommendation for her graduate application.
words.example_zh: 她的教授為她的研究所申請寫了一封特別有力的推薦信。
collocations: submit a letter of recommendation（提交推薦信）

words.example_en: Top performers are eligible for a pay raise at the end of the fiscal year.
words.example_zh: 表現優異者有資格在會計年度結束時獲得加薪。
collocations: deserve a pay raise（值得加薪）
request a pay raise（請求加薪）

words.example_en: The position requires candidates to have practical experience in software design.
words.example_zh: 該職位要求候選人具備軟體設計的實際經驗。
collocations: gain practical experience（獲得實務經驗）

words.example_en: You need to present proof of employment to apply for the bank loan.
words.example_zh: 您需要出示在職證明書才能申請銀行貸款。
collocations: provide proof of employment（提供在職證明）

words.example_en: Unsuccessful candidates are encouraged to reapply after six months.
words.example_zh: 鼓勵未獲錄取的候選人在六個月後再次申請。
collocations: reapply for a position（重新申請某職位）

words.example_en: Please attach your recommendation letter to your online application.
words.example_zh: 請將您的推薦信附於您的線上申請中。
collocations: attach a recommendation letter（附上推薦信）

words.example_en: The applicant submitted a glowing reference letter from his former manager.
words.example_zh: 應徵者提交了前經理寫的高度的讚揚推薦信。
collocations: request a reference letter（請求推薦信）

words.example_en: I will send off the application files to the selection committee today.
words.example_zh: 我今天會將申請檔案寄出給遴選委員會。

words.example_en: The coordinator will call you to set up an interview with the department head.
words.example_zh: 協調員將打電話給您，安排與部門主管的面試。
collocations: set up an interview schedule（安排面試時程）

words.example_en: All candidates must take an examination to evaluate their technical skills.
words.example_zh: 所有候選人必須接受測驗以評估其技術能力。
collocations: take an entrance examination（參加入學/入職測驗）

words.example_en: The company established a regional training center to develop young leaders.
words.example_zh: 該公司建立了一個區域訓練中心來培養年輕領導者。
collocations: corporate training center（企業培訓中心）

words.example_en: Please take a seat in the waiting room while we prepare your interview.
words.example_zh: 在我們準備您的面試時，請在等候室稍坐。

words.definition: 受過良好教育的，有教養的
words.example_en: The company values well-educated professionals with global perspectives.
words.example_zh: 該公司看重受過良好教育且具備全球視野的專業人士。
collocations: highly well-educated staff（高素質/受過良好教育的員工）

words.example_en: Each new employee is provided with an ergonomic work station.
words.example_zh: 每位新員工都配有一個符合人體工學的工作站。

words.example_en: The sales team was zealous about promoting the new line of products.
words.example_zh: 銷售團隊對推廣新產品線非常熱衷。

words.example_en: Don't forget to attach a custom cover letter with your resume.
words.example_zh: 不要忘記隨履歷附上客製化的求職信。
collocations: attach a cover letter（附上求職信）

words.example_en: She is a devoted employee who always goes the extra mile for the team.
words.example_zh: 她是一位全心投入的員工，總是為團隊付出更多努力。

words.example_en: We are seeking an energetic team leader to run our operations.
words.example_zh: 我們正在尋找一位精力充沛的團隊領導者來管理營運。

words.example_en: The recruits were enthusiastic about learning new technologies.
words.example_zh: 新員工對學習新技術充滿熱情。

words.example_en: She excels in creative problem solving and project execution.
words.example_zh: 她在創造性地解決問題和專案執行方面表現優異。
collocations: excel in/at（在……方面勝過/表現優異）

words.example_en: The final report excluded data from the preliminary trials.
words.example_zh: 最終報告排除了初試階段的數據。

words.example_en: The sales representative speaks fluently in three foreign languages.
words.example_zh: 該銷售代表能流利地講三種外語。

words.example_en: Only half of the applicants managed to get through the preliminary screening.
words.example_zh: 只有一半的應徵者成功通過了初步篩選。
collocations: get through the interview（通過面試）

words.example_en: Your skills match the requirements of this role perfectly.
words.example_zh: 您的技能與該職位的要求完美相符。

words.example_en: Continuous learning is a necessity in today's fast-changing business environment.
words.example_zh: 在當今快速變化的商業環境中，持續學習是必要的。

words.example_en: He possesses all the academic qualifications required for the research post.
words.example_zh: 他具備該研究職位所需的所有學術資格。

words.example_en: Please provide relevant details regarding your previous work experience.
words.example_zh: 請提供與您先前工作經驗相關的細節。

words.example_en: Over fifty staff members signed up for the leadership training session.
words.example_zh: 五十多名員工報名參加了領導力培訓課程。
collocations: sign up for a seminar（報名研討會）

words.example_en: Our agency aims to recruit talented individuals from across the globe.
words.example_zh: 我們的機構旨在從全球各地招募有天賦的人才。

words.example_en: The visiting delegation toured our manufacturing plant yesterday.
words.example_zh: 參訪團昨天參觀了我們的製造工廠。

words.example_en: The company plans to expand its global workforce by fifteen percent next year.
words.example_zh: 該公司計劃明年將其全球員工數量擴大百分之十五。

words.example_en: The guest speaker addressed the audience on the topic of AI development.
words.example_zh: 主講嘉賓就 AI 發展的主題對聽眾進行了演說。
collocations: address the meeting（在會議上致詞）

words.example_en: Interviewers should avoid being influenced by appearance during evaluation.
words.example_zh: 面試官在評估時應避免受到外表的影響。
collocations: unduly influenced by appearance（過度受外表影響）

words.example_en: The firm is looking for a bilingual assistant fluent in English and Spanish.
words.example_zh: 該公司正在尋找一位精通英語和西班牙語的雙語助理。

words.example_en: Please submit your curriculum vitae along with certified copies of your diploma.
words.example_zh: 請提交您的履歷書以及您畢業證書的認證影本。
collocations: submit a curriculum vitae（提交履歷書）

words.example_en: She earned a high school diploma before entering technical college.
words.example_zh: 她在進入技術學院之前獲得了高中文憑。

words.example_en: Working long hours requires physical and mental endurance.
words.example_zh: 長時間工作需要體力和精神上的忍耐力。

words.example_en: Language fluency is mandatory for working at our overseas branches.
words.example_zh: 具備流暢的語言能力是在我們海外分公司工作的必備條件。

words.example_en: The candidate is fluent in Japanese and Korean.
words.example_zh: 該候選人精通日語和韓語。
collocations: be fluent in English（精通英文）

words.definition: 同意；接受（計畫或提案等）
words.example_en: The committee decided to go with the proposed marketing strategy.
words.example_zh: 委員會決定採用擬議的行銷策略。
collocations: go with option A（選擇方案 A）

words.example_en: The human resources manager oversees employee recruitment and benefits.
words.example_zh: 人力資源經理負責監督員工招聘和福利。
collocations: human resources department（人力資源部門）

words.example_en: The confidential files were improperly disposed of by the temp worker.
words.example_zh: 機密文件被臨時工處理不當。

words.example_en: She handles all customer complaints in a positive manner.
words.example_zh: 她以積極的態度處理所有客戶投訴。
collocations: respond in a positive manner（積極回應）

words.example_en: Dr. Lee is a recognized expert in the field of renewable energy.
words.example_zh: 李博士是可再生能源領域公認的專家。
collocations: in the field of technology（在科技領域）

words.example_en: Despite his inexperience, he managed the project with great enthusiasm.
words.example_zh: 儘管缺乏經驗，他還是懷著極大的熱情管理了這個專案。
collocations: youth and inexperience（年輕且缺乏經驗）

words.example_en: New staff members may lack confidence when presenting to executives.
words.example_zh: 新員工向高管簡報時可能會缺乏自信。
collocations: severely lack confidence（嚴重缺乏自信）

words.example_en: Make review of project progress a regular habit to stay on track.
words.example_zh: 把審視專案進度變成一種習慣，以保持按計畫進行。
collocations: make it a regular habit（養成習慣）

words.definition: 為～做出奉獻，對～做出承諾
words.example_en: Our company made a commitment to reducing carbon emissions by 30%.
words.example_zh: 我們公司承諾將碳排放量減少 30%。
collocations: make a firm commitment to（做堅定的承諾）

words.example_en: She makes a point of thanking every team member after a project completion.
words.example_zh: 專案完成後，她特意向每位團隊成員表示感謝。
collocations: make a point of checking（特別重視檢查）

words.example_en: We lack sufficient manpower to finish the construction before winter.
words.example_zh: 我們缺乏足夠的人力在冬季前完成施工。

words.example_en: He obtained his master's degree in business administration last year.
words.example_zh: 他去年獲得了企業管理碩士學位。
collocations: hold a master's degree（持有碩士學位）

words.example_en: Even a novice can operate this intuitive user interface easily.
words.example_zh: 即使是新手也能輕鬆操作這個直覺的使用者介面。

words.example_en: Employees receive their monthly paycheck via direct bank deposit.
words.example_zh: 員工透過銀行直接轉帳收到每月的薪水。

words.example_en: Working remotely requires a high degree of self-motivation.
words.example_zh: 遠距工作需要高度的自我激勵。

words.example_en: The HR system will automatically send a notification upon approval.
words.example_zh: 人資系統會在核准後自動寄出通知。
collocations: send a written notification（寄出書面通知）

words.example_en: We currently have a vacancy for an experienced software developer.
words.example_zh: 我們目前有一個資深軟體開發人員的職缺。

words.example_en: Qualified candidates are wanted for immediate hiring at our main factory.
words.example_zh: 我們總廠正在徵求合資格的候選人，立即起用。

words.example_en: Please provide a detailed work history covering the last five years.
words.example_zh: 請提供涵蓋過去五年的詳細工作經歷。
collocations: solid work history（紮實的工作經歷）

words.example_en: He presented his educational credentials during the final interview.
words.example_zh: 他在最後面試中出示了他的學歷證書。

words.example_en: She gained firsthand experience of European markets during her business trip.
words.example_zh: 她在出差期間獲得了歐洲市場的第一手經驗。

words.example_en: The hiring committee will review all applications next Monday.
words.example_zh: 招聘委員會將於下週一審查所有申請。
collocations: head of the hiring committee（招聘委員會主席）

words.example_en: He speaks three languages, not to mention his extensive business experience.
words.example_zh: 他會說三種語言，更不用說他豐富的商業經驗了。
collocations: not to mention the fact that（更不用說此事實）

words.example_en: Engineers may be required to work on weekends on occasion.
words.example_zh: 工程師偶爾可能需要在週末加班。

words.definition: 超過必要資格的，條件太好的
words.example_en: The HR felt he was overqualified for the entry-level analyst role.
words.example_zh: 人資覺得對於入門級分析師職位來說，他的條件太過優越了。
collocations: be overqualified for（對……來說資歷過剩）

words.example_en: The initial screening process reduces the pool of candidates significantly.
words.example_zh: 初步篩選過程大大減少了候選人人數。

words.example_en: Production output lagged behind schedule due to machine failure.
words.example_zh: 由於機器故障，生產輸出落後於預定進度。

words.example_en: Her name was placed on the waiting list for the popular seminar.
words.example_zh: 她的名字被列入這個熱門研討會的候補名單上。
collocations: place on the waiting list（列入候補名單）

words.definition: 以～為方向的，以～為目的的
words.example_en: Our company is looking for a result-oriented project manager.
words.example_zh: 我們公司正在尋找一位以結果為導向的專案經理。

words.example_en: Please send all inquiries pertaining to legal contracts to our legal team.
words.example_zh: 請將所有與法律合約相關的查詢寄給我們的法律團隊。
collocations: documents pertaining to（與……相關的文件）

words.example_en: The financial records were stored questionably in an unencrypted folder.
words.example_zh: 這些財務記錄令人疑慮地儲存在未加密的資料夾中。

words.example_en: Safety checks are performed with strict regularity every month.
words.example_zh: 每月都會以嚴格的規律性進行安全檢查。

words.example_en: The warehouse manager needs to replenish office supplies immediately.
words.example_zh: 倉庫經理需要立即補充辦公用品。

words.example_en: Users appreciate the simplicity and efficiency of the new software.
words.example_zh: 使用者欣賞新軟體的簡潔與高效。
collocations: for the sake of simplicity（為了簡便起見）

words.example_en: She received a promotion due to her stellar sales performance this quarter.
words.example_zh: 由於本季顯著的銷售表現，她獲得了晉升。

words.example_en: He is a versatile employee who can handle marketing and graphic design.
words.example_zh: 他是一位多才多藝的員工，能處理行銷和平面設計。

words.example_en: Our lead developer is highly adept at solving complex database problems.
words.example_zh: 我們的主導開發人員非常精通解決複雜的資料庫問題。

words.example_en: Against all odds, the team delivered the software project right on time.
words.example_zh: 克服一切困難，團隊準時交付了軟體專案。
collocations: succeed against all odds（逆境中獲得成功）

words.example_en: An executive must have strong command over financial planning.
words.example_zh: 主管必須對財務規劃擁有強大的控制力。
collocations: have good command of（精通/掌握……）

words.example_en: Salary will be commensurate with the candidate's experience and skills.
words.example_zh: 薪資將與候選人的經驗及技能相稱。

words.example_en: All clerical staff are expected to be fully computer literate.
words.example_zh: 預期所有文職人員都能完全熟練使用電腦。
collocations: highly computer literate（精通電腦操作）

words.example_en: The applicant demonstrated a clear eagerness to learn new systems.
words.example_zh: 該應徵者展現了學習新系統的明確熱情。
collocations: eagerness to learn（求知慾/學習熱情）

words.example_en: Take time to familiarize yourself with the office security rules.
words.example_zh: 花點時間讓自己熟悉辦公室的安全規則。
collocations: familiarize oneself with procedures（熟悉流程）

words.example_en: Employees receive an annual salary increment based on performance reviews.
words.example_zh: 員工會根據績效考核獲得年度調薪額度。
collocations: in increments of（以……為單位增加）

words.example_en: Excellent interpersonal skills are crucial for customer success managers.
words.example_zh: 優秀的人際關係能力對於客戶成功經理來說至關重要。
collocations: strong interpersonal skills（強大的人際社交能力）

words.example_en: Management should be mindful of employee workload to prevent burnout.
words.example_zh: 管理層應留心員工的工作負擔以防止過勞。

words.example_en: He is considered the preeminent authority on corporate tax law.
words.example_zh: 他被認為是公司稅法領域最卓越的權威人士。

words.example_en: The team presented their preliminary findings at the morning meeting.
words.example_zh: 團隊在晨會上展示了他們的初步調查結果。

words.definition: 前提 / 事先準備好的
words.example_en: A master's degree is a prerequisite for entry into this research level.
words.example_zh: 碩士學位是進入該研究級別的前提條件。

words.example_en: Each probationer is assigned a senior mentor during the trial period.
words.example_zh: 在試用期間，每位試用人員都會配有一位資深導師。

words.example_en: The supervisor sternly reminded the staff to adhere to safety protocols.
words.example_zh: 主管嚴厲地提醒員工遵守安全協定。

description: 包含辦公室守則、服裝儀容規定、合約條款與法律遵行相關詞彙

words.example_en: The final budget proposal is pending written approval from the board.
words.example_zh: 最終預算提案正在等待董事會的書面批准。

words.example_en: All visitors must present a valid form of identification at the security gate.
words.example_zh: 所有訪客必須在安檢口出示有效的身分證明文件。
collocations: a form of identification（一種身分證明）

words.example_en: The new safety protocol will take effect immediately after the announcement.
words.example_zh: 新的安全協定將在宣布後立即生效。

words.example_en: Routine safety inspections are conducted every month to prevent accidents.
words.example_zh: 每月都會進行例行安全檢查以防止事故發生。

words.example_en: The travel coordinator has made all the arrangements for the international conference.
words.example_zh: 旅遊協調員已為國際會議做好了所有安排。

words.example_en: Please follow the standard emergency procedures in the event of a fire.
words.example_zh: 發生火災時，請遵循標準緊急應變程序。
collocations: standard operating procedure（標準作業程序）

words.example_en: The company received negative feedback regarding its recent price increase.
words.example_zh: 該公司收到了關於最近調漲價格的負面回饋。

words.definition: 使～成為必須（做）的 / 授權，命令
words.example_en: The corporate policy mandates that all employees wear ID badges on site.
words.example_zh: 公司政策規定所有員工在現場必須配戴識別證。

words.definition: （法律等的）效力；效果；影響 / 造成（結果）
words.example_en: The revised tax regulation will come into effect starting next quarter.
words.example_zh: 修改後的稅務法規將於下一季度開始生效。
collocations: have an effect on（對……產生影響）

words.example_en: The company drastically reduced operational expenses to survive the downturn.
words.example_zh: 該公司大幅削減營運費用以度過低迷期。

words.example_en: According to the financial report, revenue increased by ten percent this year.
words.example_zh: 根據財務報告，今年的收入成長了百分之十。
collocations: according to guidelines（根據指導方針）

words.example_en: The new automation tool will enable staff to process orders much faster.
words.example_zh: 新的自動化工具將使員工能夠更快地處理訂單。
collocations: enable someone to do（使某人能夠做……）

words.example_en: All products must meet strict quality standards before being shipped.
words.example_zh: 所有產品在發貨前必須符合嚴格的品質標準。

words.example_en: The customer service team handles a constant stream of phone inquiries daily.
words.example_zh: 客戶服務團隊每天都要處理源源不絕的電話詢問。

words.definition: 法案，法令；行為 / 擔當；行動
words.example_en: Congress passed a new act to protect consumer privacy online.
words.example_zh: 國會通過了一項新法案來保護網路消費者的隱私。
collocations: act on behalf of（代表……行動）

words.example_en: The company offered fair compensation to workers affected by the layoff.
words.example_zh: 該公司向受裁員影響的工人提供了合理的補償。

words.example_en: The government imposed a ban on single-use plastic bags in retail stores.
words.example_zh: 政府禁止零售商店使用一次性塑膠袋。

words.example_en: Employers have a legal obligation to provide a safe working environment.
words.example_zh: 雇主有法律義務提供安全的工作環境。

words.example_en: Only the chief executive officer can authorize expenditures exceeding $10,000.
words.example_zh: 只有執行長才能授權超過一萬美元的支出。

words.example_en: Company regulations strictly prohibit taking internal documents out of the office.
words.example_zh: 公司規定嚴格禁止將內部文件帶出辦公室。
collocations: prohibit someone from doing（禁止某人做……）

words.example_en: The board voted to abolish the outdated paper filing system completely.
words.example_zh: 董事會投票決定完全廢除過時的紙本歸檔系統。

words.example_en: Security officers are responsible for enforcing traffic rules within the facility.
words.example_zh: 安衛人員負責在廠區內執行交通規則。

words.example_en: Developing good time management habits can improve daily productivity.
words.example_zh: 養成良好的時間管理習慣可以提高日常生產力。

words.example_en: The government is introducing new legislation to regulate digital currencies.
words.example_zh: 政府正在推行新立法以規範數位貨幣。

words.example_en: Access to confidential server logs is restricted to IT administrators.
words.example_zh: 存取機密伺服器紀錄僅限於 IT 管理員。
collocations: restrict access to（限制對……的存取權）
restrict A to B（將 A 限制在 B 範圍內）

words.example_en: The worker had to bend over to pick up the safety equipment from the floor.
words.example_zh: 工人不得不彎腰從地上撿起安全設備。
collocations: bend over to do（彎腰去做……）

words.example_en: The new manager completed the legal compliance report entirely by himself.
words.example_zh: 新經理完全獨立完成了法律合規報告。
collocations: do something by oneself（獨立完成某事）

words.example_en: Please check the expiration date on the contract before signing.
words.example_zh: 簽署前請確認合約上的到期日期。

words.example_en: It took the team a few weeks to get used to the new safety regulations.
words.example_zh: 團隊花了幾週時間才習慣新的安全規定。
collocations: get used to the new system（習慣新系統）

words.example_en: If it's okay with you, we can reschedule the legal briefing for tomorrow.
words.example_zh: 如果您可以接受的話，我們可以將法律簡報改期到明天。
collocations: if it's okay with you（如果您不介意的話）

words.example_en: In case of emergency, press the alarm button immediately.
words.example_zh: 萬一遇到緊急情況，請立即按下警報按鈕。
collocations: in case of emergency（萬一發生緊急狀況）

words.example_en: The chairs in the auditorium were arranged neatly in rows for the hearing.
words.example_zh: 禮堂裡的椅子一排排整齊排列著以準備進行公聽會。

words.example_en: The first item on the agenda is the review of corporate policies.
words.example_zh: 議程上的第一個項目是審查公司政策。

words.example_en: The company consulted its legal team before proceeding with the acquisition.
words.example_zh: 該公司在進行併購前諮詢了其法律團隊。

words.example_en: Due to budget cuts, the firm had to let go of several junior employees.
words.example_zh: 由於預算削減，該公司不得不解僱幾名初級員工。
collocations: let go of employees（解僱員工）

words.example_en: The architect used a precise stainless steel ruler to check the blueprint.
words.example_zh: 建築師使用精密的白鋼尺來核對藍圖。

words.example_en: The factory manager ordered the workers to stop operations during the inspection.
words.example_zh: 廠長在檢查期間下令工人停止作業。

words.example_en: The legal department has been extremely busy preparing for the upcoming court trial.
words.example_zh: 法務部一直非常忙於為即將到來的庭審做準備。

words.example_en: The training curriculum includes mandatory modules on corporate ethics.
words.example_zh: 培訓課程包含公司道德的必修模組。

words.example_en: All employees are expected to adhere to the company dress code.
words.example_zh: 所有員工都被要求遵守公司的服裝儀容規定。

words.definition: 足夠的 / 足夠充分的數量
words.example_en: We have enough evidence to prove that the company complied with the law.
words.example_zh: 我們有足夠的證據證明該公司遵守了法律。

words.example_en: Please finish reviewing the contract before submitting it to the client.
words.example_zh: 請在提交給客戶前完成合約審查。

words.example_en: Many users had a problem in accessing the updated privacy terms.
words.example_zh: 許多使用者在存取更新後的隱私條款時遇到問題。
collocations: have a problem in understanding（理解上有困難）

words.example_en: A large portion of the budget was allocated to legal defense.
words.example_zh: 預算的大部分被分配給法律辯護。

words.example_en: She hired a prestigious law firm to handle the patent infringement case.
words.example_zh: 她聘請了一家知名的法律事務所來處理專利侵權案。
collocations: international law firm（國際律師事務所）

words.example_en: Please do not speak loudly in the library or quiet study zones.
words.example_zh: 請勿在圖書館或安靜的自習區大聲喧嘩。

words.example_en: The basic salary is $5,000 plus a performance-based annual bonus.
words.example_zh: 基本薪資為五千美元，外加基於績效的年度獎金。

words.example_en: The new copyright law is designed to protect intellectual property rights.
words.example_zh: 新版權法旨在保護智慧財產權。

words.example_en: The company seldom changes its core internal operating guidelines.
words.example_zh: 該公司很少更改其核心內部作業準則。

words.example_en: The security camera footage helped the police solve the identity theft case.
words.example_zh: 監視器畫面幫助警方破獲了該起身分竊盜案。

words.example_en: We will try our best to resolve the legal dispute out of court.
words.example_zh: 我們將盡最大努力在法庭外解決法律糾紛。

words.definition: 目擊者；目擊證人 / 目擊
words.example_en: The key witness was asked to testify during the court session.
words.example_zh: 關鍵證人被要求在庭審期間出庭作證。

words.example_en: Our attorney will write a formal letter of complaint to the supplier.
words.example_zh: 我們的律師將向供應商寫一封正式的投訴信。

words.example_en: It is strictly against the law to operate heavy machinery without proper certification.
words.example_zh: 無適當認證操作重型機械是完全違法的。

words.example_en: By all means, contact our legal counsel if you have further questions.
words.example_zh: 如果您有其他疑問，務必聯絡我們的法律顧問。

words.example_en: Confidential financial information was sent to an external client by mistake.
words.example_zh: 機密財務資訊不小心被發送給了外部客戶。

words.example_en: The exclusive distribution agreement will come to an end next month.
words.example_zh: 獨家分銷協議將於下個月結束。
collocations: come to a close（進入尾聲）

words.example_en: Employees must strictly follow all company regulations regarding privacy.
words.example_zh: 員工必須嚴格遵守公司有關隱私的所有規定。
collocations: comply with company regulations（遵守公司規定）

words.example_en: The supervisor gave clear directions on how to handle safety violations.
words.example_zh: 主管就如何處理安全違規給出了明確的指示。
collocations: give clear directions（給予明確指示）

words.example_en: Unexpected regulatory delays held up the building project for weeks.
words.example_zh: 意料之外的法規延誤使該建築專案停滯了數週。

words.definition: 如果我的了解沒錯的話
words.example_en: If I'm not mistaken, the contract renewal deadline is next Friday.
words.example_zh: 如果我沒記錯的話，續約的截止日期是下週五。
collocations: if I'm not mistaken（若我沒記錯）

words.example_en: An internal audit of financial operations is currently in progress.
words.example_zh: 財務營運的內部審計目前正在進行中。
collocations: work in progress（進行中的工作）

words.example_en: Please keep in mind that all expense reports must include receipts.
words.example_zh: 請記住，所有費用報銷報告都必須附上收據。

words.example_en: The board requested advice from expert legal counsel regarding the merger.
words.example_zh: 董事會就合併事宜向專家法律顧問尋求建議。
collocations: seek legal counsel（尋求法律諮詢）
appoint legal counsel（任命法律顧問）

words.example_en: The defendant claimed that he acted purely in self-defense during the incident.
words.example_zh: 被告聲稱他在事件發生期間完全是出於正當防衛。

words.example_en: Police are questioning a suspect in connection with the corporate fraud.
words.example_zh: 警方正在審問一名涉嫌公司詐欺案的嫌犯。

words.example_en: I strongly suggest you take the attorney's advice and sign the agreement.
words.example_zh: 我強烈建議你接受律師的勸告並簽署協議。
collocations: take legal advice（聽取法律建議）

words.example_en: The sudden shift in market policy worked to our firm's advantage.
words.example_zh: 市場政策的突然轉變對我們公司有利。
collocations: turn to one's advantage（轉變成對某人有利）

words.example_en: The security team assured management that the risk is completely under control.
words.example_zh: 安全團隊向管理層保證風險完全在控制之中。
collocations: bring under control（使其處於控制之下）

words.example_en: Trainees must operate machinery under the supervision of certified engineers.
words.example_zh: 受訓人員必須在合格工程師的監督下操作機械。
collocations: under direct supervision of（在……的直接監督下）

words.example_en: The audit revealed an abuse of company funds by a senior executive.
words.example_zh: 審計揭露了一位高階主管濫用公司資金的情況。

words.definition: 提醒（某人）注意 / 警覺的
words.example_en: Security guards remained alert throughout the international summit.
words.example_zh: 安全人員在整個國際高峰會期間保持警惕。

words.example_en: The committee conducted a comprehensive risk assessment before investing.
words.example_zh: 委員會在投資前進行了全面的風險評估。

words.example_en: Safety goggles must be worn inside the chemical factory at all times.
words.example_zh: 化學工廠內必須隨時配戴安全護目鏡。
collocations: available at all times（隨時可用）

words.example_en: You cannot access customer data files without official authorization.
words.example_zh: 未經官方授權，您不得存取客戶資料檔案。

words.example_en: The legal department issued a memorandum concerning the new privacy laws.
words.example_zh: 法務部發布了一份關於新隱私法的備忘錄。

words.example_en: Your proposal is currently under active consideration by the board.
words.example_zh: 您的提案目前正由董事會積極考慮中。

words.example_en: The company took a defensive stance after the patent lawsuit was filed.
words.example_zh: 提起專利訴訟後，該公司採取了防禦姿態。

words.example_en: The report gives an accurate depiction of the current regulatory environment.
words.example_zh: 該報告對目前的監管環境給出了準確的描述。

words.example_en: Disobedient staff members who break safety rules will face disciplinary action.
words.example_zh: 違反安全規定的不服從員工將面臨處分行動。

words.example_en: The firm managed to endure economic hardships during the recession.
words.example_zh: 該公司在經濟衰退期間成功挺過了經濟困難。

words.example_en: He received an award for his exemplary compliance record.
words.example_zh: 他因模範的合規紀錄而獲得獎項。

words.example_en: Employees should never ignore corporate safety guidelines.
words.example_zh: 員工絕不應忽視公司的安全指導方針。

words.example_en: Downloading copyrighted material without authorization is illegal.
words.example_zh: 未經授權下載受版權保護的資料是違法的。

words.example_en: All financial statements were prepared in accordance with international standards.
words.example_zh: 所有財務報表均按照國際標準編製。
collocations: in accordance with regulations（依據法規）

words.example_en: Indecisive leadership can cause significant delays in major projects.
words.example_zh: 優柔寡斷的領導層可能會導致重大專案的嚴重延誤。

words.example_en: The manager acted justly when resolving disputes among employees.
words.example_zh: 經理在解決員工之間的爭議時表現得十分公正。

words.example_en: All workers are required to obey safety regulations on the job site.
words.example_zh: 所有工人都必須遵守工作現場的安全規定。

words.example_en: Strict observance of environmental policies is monitored by the local authority.
words.example_zh: 當地主管機關監督對環保政策的嚴格遵守。

words.example_en: The company provides an on-site medical clinic for all factory workers.
words.example_zh: 該公司為所有工廠工人提供現場醫療診所。

words.example_en: Failure to pay taxes on time will result in a heavy financial penalty.
words.example_zh: 未能按時繳稅將導致重大的經濟處罰。

words.definition: （說話或表現等）尖銳的，深刻的
words.example_en: The auditor asked several pointed questions about the missing records.
words.example_zh: 審計師就缺失的紀錄提出了幾個尖銳的問題。

words.example_en: Confidential client research is one of the company's most precious assets.
words.example_zh: 機密客戶研究是公司最珍貴的資產之一。

words.example_en: The company operates strictly on principles of transparency and fairness.
words.example_zh: 該公司嚴格依據透明和公平的原則營運。

words.example_en: Violation of the non-disclosure agreement will result in legal punishment.
words.example_zh: 違反保密協議將導致法律處罰。

words.example_en: Government authorities heavily regulate the pharmaceutical industry.
words.example_zh: 政府主管機關對製藥業進行嚴格監管。

words.example_en: Unauthorized staff are strictly prohibited from entering the restricted area.
words.example_zh: 未經授權的人員嚴禁進入限制區域。
collocations: enter a restricted area（進入管制區）

words.example_en: The government imposed tight trade restrictions on imported electronic goods.
words.example_zh: 政府對進口電子產品實施了嚴格的貿易限制。

words.example_en: The factory passed the annual safety inspection with zero violations.
words.example_zh: 該工廠通過了年度安全檢查，零違規。
collocations: pass a safety inspection（通過安檢）

words.example_en: The company tried to suppress negative reports about product defects.
words.example_zh: 該公司試圖壓制有關產品缺陷的負面報導。

words.example_en: The board members waited tensely for the voting results of the proposal.
words.example_zh: 董事會成員緊張地等待提案的投票結果。

words.example_en: Unauthorized access to client confidential records will lead to dismissal.
words.example_zh: 未經授權存取客戶機密記錄將導致解僱。

words.example_en: The lawyer raised several points with respect to the liability clause.
words.example_zh: 律師就責任條款提出了幾點意見。
collocations: with respect to the contract（關於合約）

words.example_en: The company was accused of violating international trade compliance laws.
words.example_zh: 該公司被控違反國際貿易合規法。

words.example_en: An independent auditor was hired to assess the company's financial status.
words.example_zh: 聘請了一位獨立審計師來評估公司的財務狀況。

words.example_en: The defense attorney presented key evidence during the afternoon trial.
words.example_zh: 辯護律師在下午的庭審中出示了關鍵證據。

words.example_en: Several board members were absent from the annual general meeting.
words.example_zh: 幾位董事會成員缺席了股東常會。

words.example_en: Visitors are allowed to enter the research building with a guest pass.
words.example_zh: 訪客持訪客證獲准進入研究大樓。
collocations: be allowed to enter（獲准進入）

words.example_en: The notice was officially delivered to shareholders by way of email.
words.example_zh: 該通知已透過電子郵件正式送達給股東。
collocations: by way of explanation（作為解釋）

words.example_en: Lacks of transparency created deep distrust between management and employees.
words.example_zh: 缺乏透明度導致管理層與員工之間產生極度不信任。

words.example_en: From this day onward, all internal communications must follow new security rules.
words.example_zh: 從今天起，所有內部通訊都必須遵守新的安全規則。
collocations: from this day onward（從今以後）

words.example_en: Only senior managers have permission to approve travel expenses.
words.example_zh: 只有資深經理有權批准差旅費用。
collocations: obtain permission to do（獲得做……的許可）

words.example_en: All fire codes are enforced in a strict way by the safety inspector.
words.example_zh: 安全檢查員嚴格執行所有消防法規。
collocations: enforced in a strict way（嚴格執行）

words.example_en: The CEO made clear that ethical conduct is non-negotiable for all staff.
words.example_zh: 執行長明確指出，道德行為對所有員工來說都是不可談判的。

words.example_en: The project received approval from the Ministry of Finance yesterday.
words.example_zh: 該專案昨天獲得財政部的批准。

words.example_en: The newly established task force will oversee corporate governance.
words.example_zh: 新成立的專案小組將負責監督公司治理。
collocations: newly established company（新成立的公司）

words.example_en: The revised safety rules will be put into effect starting next Monday.
words.example_zh: 修訂後的安全規則將於下週一起生效。
collocations: put regulations into effect（使法規生效）

words.example_en: You will receive a registration confirmation email within twenty-four hours.
words.example_zh: 您將在二十四小時內收到登記確認電子郵件。
collocations: send registration confirmation（寄送註冊確認信）

words.example_en: The senior technician had to stand over the apprentice during the experiment.
words.example_zh: 實驗過程中，資深技術員必須監督實習生。

words.example_en: The HR manager warned employees against sharing passwords.
words.example_zh: 人資經理警告員工不要共享密碼。

words.example_en: The safety rules apply to all workers without respect to their job rank.
words.example_zh: 無論職位高低，安全規則適用於所有工人。
collocations: without respect to rank（不論職級）

words.definition: 尋常的事物 / 平凡的，普通的多益
words.example_en: Remote meetings have become commonplace in international corporations.
words.example_zh: 遠距會議在國際公司中已變得十分尋常。

words.example_en: Lab technicians must wear a protective smock when handling chemicals.
words.example_zh: 實驗室技術人員處理化學品時必須穿著防護服。
collocations: wear a protective smock（穿著防護服）

words.example_en: The witness provided crucial testimony during the court trial.
words.example_zh: 證人在庭審期間提供了關鍵證詞。

words.example_en: The operations were conducted in accordance with strict environmental laws.
words.example_zh: 該作業是按照嚴格的環保法律進行的。

words.example_en: Timely compliance is crucial for maintaining corporate credibility.
words.example_zh: 及時合規對於維持公司信譽至關重要。

words.example_en: Any deviation from standard protocol must be logged and reported.
words.example_zh: 任何偏離標準協定之處都必須記錄並上報。

words.example_en: The experienced attorney handled the complex negotiations effortlessly.
words.example_zh: 這位經驗豐富的律師輕鬆處理了複雜的談判。

words.example_en: The office will be closed on Monday in observance of the national holiday.
words.example_zh: 為因應國定假日，辦公室將於週一關閉。
collocations: in observance of national holiday（因應國定假日）

words.example_en: Confidential files were inadvertently disclosed during the press briefing.
words.example_zh: 機密文件在記者會期間不慎被公開。

words.example_en: The case is currently under judicial review by the Supreme Court.
words.example_zh: 該案目前正在最高法院進行司法覆核。

words.example_en: The manager provided detailed justification for the budget increase.
words.example_zh: 經理為增加預算提供了詳細的正當理由。

words.definition: 敏銳地；敏銳地；強烈地；熱心地
words.example_en: Management is keenly aware of the growing competitive market pressures.
words.example_zh: 管理層敏銳地意識到日益增加的市場競爭壓力。

words.example_en: The firm faced a massive lawsuit over alleged patent infringement.
words.example_zh: 該公司因涉嫌專利侵權而面臨巨額訴訟。

words.example_en: Automating mundane office tasks allowed staff to focus on strategic planning.
words.example_zh: 將平凡乏味的辦公室任務自動化讓員工能專注於戰略規劃。

words.example_en: The construction site is off-limits to personnel without safety gear.
words.example_zh: 無安全裝備的人員嚴禁進入施工現場。

words.example_en: The city council passed a new local ordinance regarding noise restrictions.
words.example_zh: 市議會通過了一項關於噪音限制的新地方法令。

words.example_en: The defective product batch was pulled from store shelves immediately.
words.example_zh: 有缺陷的產品批次已立即從商店貨架上撤下。

words.example_en: The employee was reprimanded for failing to adhere to safety rules.
words.example_zh: 該員工因未遵守安全規則而受到訓斥。

words.example_en: The board of directors passed a formal resolution to approve the merger.
words.example_zh: 董事會通過了一項正式決議批准合併。

words.example_en: Companies face stiff penalties for non-compliance with data safety laws.
words.example_zh: 公司若不遵守資料安全法將面臨嚴厲的處罰。

words.example_en: The auditor requested documents to substantiate the business expenses.
words.example_zh: 審計師要求出示文件以證實這些業務支出。

words.example_en: Anyone who attempts to trespass on private corporate property will be prosecuted.
words.example_zh: 任何試圖非法侵入公司私有財產的人都將被起訴。

words.example_en: Disclosing confidential source code violates the signed employment agreement.
words.example_zh: 洩露機密原始碼違反了簽署的僱用協議。

words.example_en: Annual bonuses are granted strictly at the discretion of executive management.
words.example_zh: 年終獎金嚴格由高階管理層裁定發放。
collocations: at sole discretion of（完全由……裁定）

words.definition: 有義務的，一定要做什麼的
words.example_en: All partners are legally bound by the non-disclosure agreement.
words.example_zh: 所有合夥人在法律上均受保密協議約束。

words.example_en: The authority of the interim director was strictly circumscribed by the board.
words.example_zh: 代理主管的權限受到了董事會的嚴格限制。

words.example_en: The enactment of new environmental laws forced factories to upgrade equipment.
words.example_zh: 新環保法律的頒布迫使工廠升級設備。
collocations: enactment of legislation（法規之頒布/制定）

words.example_en: The firm maintains an impeccable record of regulatory compliance.
words.example_zh: 該公司保持著無可挑剔的法規合規紀錄。

words.example_en: The tech company filed a lawsuit over copyright infringement.
words.example_zh: 該科技公司針對侵犯版權的行為提起了訴訟。

words.example_en: The auditor verified that all claimed expenses were legitimate business costs.
words.example_zh: 審計師核實了所有申報的費用均為合法的業務支出。

words.example_en: Employees submitted a formal petition requesting flexible working hours.
words.example_zh: 員工提交了一份正式請願書請求彈性工作時間。

words.example_en: When it comes to legal compliance, the company takes zero risks.
words.example_zh: 說到法律合規，該公司絕不冒任何風險。
collocations: when it comes to safety（談到安全時）

topic_title: 職場日常與業務執行 (一)
description: 包含基礎辦公室日常作業、交辦事項與工作流程相關詞彙

words.example_en: Our engineering team is fully accustomed to working under tight project deadlines.
words.example_zh: 我們的工程團隊完全習慣在緊迫的專案截止日期下工作。

words.example_en: The multinational corporation announced plans to expand its research facilities in Asia.
words.example_zh: 該跨國公司宣布了擴建其亞洲研究設施的計劃。

words.example_en: Managing complex supply chains can be a highly demanding role in retail.
words.example_zh: 在零售業中，管理複雜的供應鏈可能是一項要求極高的職務。
collocations: demanding job（吃力/要求高的工作）

words.example_en: She collaborated closely with her colleagues from the marketing department.
words.example_zh: 她與行銷部門的同事進行了密切合作。

words.example_en: He was recently appointed as the head of the software development division.
words.example_zh: 他最近被任命為軟體開發部門的主管。

words.example_en: You may request additional office supplies by submitting a form to administrative staff.
words.example_zh: 您可以透過向行政人員提交表格來申請額外的辦公用品。

words.example_en: The upgraded workflow management system helps employees process invoices efficiently.
words.example_zh: 升級後的工作流程管理系統有助於員工高效處理發票。

words.example_en: Despite the delay, the team managed to complete the prototype ahead of the launch event.
words.example_zh: 儘管有所延誤，團隊還是設法在發布會前完成了原型製作。
collocations: under new management（在新管理層領導下）

words.example_en: All employees must submit their weekly expense reports before Friday afternoon.
words.example_zh: 所有員工必須在週五下午之前提交每週費用報告。
collocations: submit A to B（將 A 提交給 B）

words.example_en: Regional sales representatives report directly to the Vice President of Sales.
words.example_zh: 區域銷售代表直接向銷售副總裁報告。

words.example_en: The system automatically sends an email to remind clients of upcoming invoice payments.
words.example_zh: 系統會自動發送電子郵件以提醒客戶即將到期的發票付款。
collocations: remind someone of（提醒某人某事）
remind someone to do（提醒某人去做……）

words.example_en: The manager instructed staff to review the new safety guidelines thoroughly.
words.example_zh: 經理指示員工仔細審閱新的安全指南。
collocations: instruct someone to do（指示某人去做……）

words.example_en: Meeting the project deadline is essential for maintaining client trust.
words.example_zh: 趕上專案截止日期對於維持客戶信任至關重要。
collocations: meet a deadline（趕上截止日期）
extend a deadline（延長截止日期）

words.definition: 樣本，試用品 / 試吃；抽樣檢查
words.example_en: We distributed product samples to attendees during the annual trade show.
words.example_zh: 我們在年度貿易展期間向與會者分發了產品樣品。

words.example_en: Human resources will notify successful applicants by phone early next week.
words.example_zh: 人力資源部將於下週初透過電話通知錄取的應徵者。
collocations: notify someone of（通知某人某事）

words.example_en: Maintenance technicians perform regular system checks to prevent downtime.
words.example_zh: 維修技術人員定期進行系統檢查以防止停機。

words.definition: 監視，監控，監督 / 監視器
words.example_en: The supervisor will closely monitor the progress of the software rollout.
words.example_zh: 主管將密切監控軟體推出的進度。

words.example_en: The team deserves recognition for completing the challenging project ahead of schedule.
words.example_zh: 該團隊因提前完成這項具挑戰性的專案而值得讚揚。

words.example_en: She accepted an overseas assignment to lead the expansion project in London.
words.example_zh: 她接受了一項海外任務，前往倫敦領導擴張專案。

words.example_en: The entire department gathered in the main conference room for the annual briefing.
words.example_zh: 整個部門在主會議室聚集參加年度簡報。

words.definition: 發表，公開 / 發行，上市
words.example_en: The software firm plans to release the new version of its application next month.
words.example_zh: 該軟體公司計劃下個月發行其應用程式的新版本。

words.example_en: Please write down your contact information on a sheet of paper.
words.example_zh: 請在一張紙上寫下您的聯絡資訊。

words.example_en: He handed his business card to the prospective client after the meeting.
words.example_zh: 會議結束後，他將名片遞給了潛在客戶。

words.example_en: The printer is out of ink, so we need to replace the black ink cartridge.
words.example_zh: 印表機沒墨水了，所以我們需要更換黑色墨水匣。

words.example_en: Employees are required to check their daily schedule every morning.
words.example_zh: 員工被要求每天早晨查看每日日程表。

words.example_en: The manager asked her to edit the draft report before sending it to the director.
words.example_zh: 經理要求她在發送給總監之前編輯報告草稿。

words.example_en: Please hand these printed handouts to all the workshop participants.
words.example_zh: 請將這些列印好的講義傳遞給所有研討會參加者。

words.example_en: We must reduce operational costs in order to maintain profit margins.
words.example_zh: 為了維持利潤率，我們必須降低營運成本。
collocations: in order to improve（為了改善……）

words.example_en: Sales representatives are issued a company laptop for business trips.
words.example_zh: 業務代表獲發一台公司筆記型電腦用於出差。

words.example_en: All attendees are required to wear a name tag during the conference.
words.example_zh: 所有與會者在會議期間都必須配戴名牌。
collocations: wear a name tag（配戴名牌）

words.example_en: The department head is currently on vacation and will return next Monday.
words.example_zh: 部門主管目前正在休假，將於下週一返回。

words.example_en: Clear the paper jam in the printer before trying to print your files.
words.example_zh: 在嘗試列印文件之前，請先清除印表機中的卡紙。
collocations: cause a paper jam（造成卡紙）

words.example_en: The administrative assistant is handling the required paperwork for new hires.
words.example_zh: 行政助理正在處理新員工所需的文書工作。

words.example_en: Glass partitions were installed between workstations to reduce noise.
words.example_zh: 工作站之間安裝了玻璃隔板以減少噪音。

words.example_en: To avoid morning rush hour, she leaves home twenty minutes early every day.
words.example_zh: 為了避開早晨交通尖峰時段，她每天提早二十分鐘出門。
collocations: rush hour traffic（尖峰時段交通）

words.example_en: Please store all legal files in the archive section of the office.
words.example_zh: 請將所有法律檔案存放在辦公室的檔案區域。

words.example_en: Please write down your name on the sign-in sheet provided at the entrance.
words.example_zh: 請在入口處提供的簽到單上寫下您的名字。

words.example_en: All tabletops in the meeting rooms are cleaned at the end of each work day.
words.example_zh: 會議室裡的所有桌面會在每個工作天結束時清潔。

words.example_en: The manager was interrupted by an urgent telephone call from the overseas branch.
words.example_zh: 經理被一通來自海外分公司的緊急電話打斷了。

words.example_en: Please throw non-recyclable items into the designated trash bin.
words.example_zh: 請將不可回收物品丟入指定垃圾桶。
collocations: empty the trash bin（清空垃圾桶）

words.definition: 樓上的 / 往樓上，在樓上
words.example_en: The executive office is located upstairs on the fourth floor.
words.example_zh: 主管辦公室位於四樓樓上。

words.example_en: He spoke as if he were already fully familiar with the new operating guidelines.
words.example_zh: 他說話時彷彿已經完全熟悉了新的作業準則。

words.example_en: The job requires expertise in marketing as well as strong communication skills.
words.example_zh: 這份工作需要行銷專業知識，以及強大的溝通能力。
collocations: A as well as B（除了 B 之外還有 A）

words.example_en: All employees should be aware of the updated office safety policies.
words.example_zh: 所有員工都應該清楚了解更新後的辦公室安全政策。
collocations: be fully aware of（完全了解/察覺……）

words.example_en: The company is known as an industry leader in sustainable manufacturing.
words.example_zh: 該公司以永續製造領域的產業領導者而聞名。
collocations: be widely known as（被廣泛譽為……）

words.example_en: The board is likely to approve the merger proposal during next week's session.
words.example_zh: 董事會很可能在下週的會議上批准合併提案。
collocations: be likely to increase（很可能會增加）

words.example_en: The project plan outlines every detail of the product development timeline.
words.example_zh: 專案計劃概述了產品開發時程表的每個細節。

words.example_en: The tech firm expanded its service offering to include cloud security solution.
words.example_zh: 該科技公司擴展了其服務品項，將雲端安全解決方案納入其中。

words.example_en: After two weeks of training, the recruit was able to complete tasks on his own.
words.example_zh: 經過兩週的培訓後，新員工能夠獨立完成任務。
collocations: work on one's own（獨立工作）

words.example_en: Drivers must adjust the mirror before starting the delivery vehicle.
words.example_zh: 駕駛人在啟動送貨車前必須調整後視鏡。
collocations: adjust the side mirror（調整側邊後視鏡）

words.example_en: Due to high demand, advance reservations are required for the main conference hall.
words.example_zh: 由於需求量大，主會議廳需要事先預約。
collocations: make an advance reservation（進行事先預約）

words.example_en: The secretary will call you back to arrange an appointment with the director.
words.example_zh: 秘書會回電給您以安排與總監的會面。
collocations: arrange an appointment with（安排與……會面）

words.example_en: The new safety memo was posted on the main company bulletin board.
words.example_zh: 新的安全備忘錄已張貼在公司主布告欄上。
collocations: post on the bulletin board（張貼於布告欄）

words.example_en: Mr. Smith is currently in a meeting, but he will call back as soon as possible.
words.example_zh: 史密斯先生目前正在開會，但他會儘快回撥電話。

words.example_en: Several team members felt confused about the new filing system procedures.
words.example_zh: 幾位團隊成員對新的歸檔系統流程感到困惑。

words.example_en: The assistant was sent out to run an urgent administrative errand.
words.example_zh: 助理被派出去辦理一項緊急行政差事。

words.example_en: We would like to extend an invitation to all staff to attend the anniversary dinner.
words.example_zh: 我們想邀請全體員工參加週年晚宴。
collocations: extend an invitation to（向……發出邀請）

words.example_en: Contractors must get a permit before commencing building renovation.
words.example_zh: 承包商在開始建築翻修之前必須取得許可。
collocations: get a parking permit（取得停車許可）

words.example_en: Please hand in your completed questionnaire to the receptionist.
words.example_zh: 請將您填妥的問卷提交給櫃檯招待人員。
collocations: hand in a report（繳交報告）

words.example_en: After working overtime all week, she was allowed to have a day off on Friday.
words.example_zh: 加班一整週後，她獲准在週五休假一天。
collocations: take a day off（請假一天）

words.example_en: The engineers had a long day resolving the server failure.
words.example_zh: 工程師們度過了勞累的一天來解決伺服器故障。
collocations: have a long day at work（度過忙碌勞累的工作天）

words.example_en: She was chosen to head up the international marketing campaign.
words.example_zh: 她獲選來領導這項國際行銷活動。
collocations: head up a department（領導部門）

words.example_en: He rushed out of the office in a hurry to catch his flight to Tokyo.
words.example_zh: 他匆忙衝出辦公室去趕飛往東京的班機。
collocations: in a hurry to do（急忙去做……）

words.example_en: The client names are listed in alphabetical order on the contact directory.
words.example_zh: 通訊錄上的客戶姓名是按照字母順序排列的。
collocations: arrange in alphabetical order（按字母順序排列）

words.example_en: You are in luck because there is still one opening left for the workshop.
words.example_zh: 你很幸運，因為該研討會還有最後一個名額。

words.definition: 把 A 交給 B 處理
words.example_en: We will leave the technical decisions up to the lead software architect.
words.example_zh: 我們將把技術決定交給首席軟體架構師處理。
collocations: leave the decision up to management（將決定權交給管理層）

words.definition: 把 A 交給 B 處理
words.example_en: Please leave your contact details with my secretary before you leave.
words.example_zh: 請在離開前將您的聯絡方式留給我的秘書。
collocations: leave a message with someone（留言給某人）

words.example_en: The real estate website updated its job and property listings today.
words.example_zh: 不動產網站今天更新了其職缺與房產列表。

words.example_en: Excuse me, I need to step outside to make an urgent business call.
words.example_zh: 抱歉，我需要走到外面打一通緊急公事電話。

words.example_en: The editor made a quick correction to the typo in the press release.
words.example_zh: 編輯對新聞稿中的打字錯誤進行了快速修正。

words.example_en: We need to make a final change to the layout before going to print.
words.example_zh: 我們需要在付印前對版面進行最後的變更。

words.example_en: Please make a note of the client's special requirements during the call.
words.example_zh: 通話時請把客戶的特殊要求記錄下來。
collocations: make a note of key points（把重點記下來）

words.example_en: A well-structured presentation will help make a great impression on investors.
words.example_zh: 結構良好的簡報有助於給投資者留下深刻印象。
collocations: make a good impression（留下好印象）

words.example_en: The company decided to move ahead with the new product rollout.
words.example_zh: 該公司決定推動新產品上市計畫。
collocations: move ahead with plans（推進計劃）

words.example_en: The regional sales director is currently in Singapore on a business trip.
words.example_zh: 區域銷售總監目前在新加坡出差。
collocations: be away on a business trip（在外面出差）

words.example_en: Project team leads submit status updates on a weekly basis.
words.example_zh: 專案組長每週提交一次狀態更新。
collocations: meet on a weekly basis（每週開會）

words.definition: 為了公事，因為工作（出差）
words.example_en: He traveled to London on business to negotiate the partnership contract.
words.example_zh: 他因公出差前往倫敦洽談合作合約。

words.example_en: The security officer on duty reported no incidents during the night shift.
words.example_zh: 值班的安衛人員報告大夜班期間未發生任何事故。

words.example_en: Please pick up the phone when the receptionist transfers the call.
words.example_zh: 當接待人員轉接電話時，請接起電話。
collocations: pick up the phone immediately（立刻接起電話）

words.example_en: Maintenance workers had to scrub the floor after the chemical spill.
words.example_zh: 化學品洩漏後，維修工人不得不用力刷洗地板。

words.example_en: Please seal the envelope securely before dropping it in the mail.
words.example_zh: 投入郵箱前請將信封投遞處妥善密封。

words.example_en: The speaker was requested to speak into the microphone clearly.
words.example_zh: 講者被要求清晰地對著麥克風講話。
collocations: speak directly into the microphone（直接對著麥克風講話）

words.example_en: She was speaking on the phone with a key corporate client.
words.example_zh: 她當時正在跟一位關鍵公司客戶講電話。
collocations: speak on the phone with someone（與某人講電話）

words.example_en: Attendees had to stand in a line to collect their entry badges.
words.example_zh: 與會者必須排隊領取入場識別證。
collocations: stand in a line for registration（排隊註冊）

words.example_en: If Mr. Jackson is unavailable, I can take a message for him.
words.example_zh: 如果傑克森先生不方便接聽，我可以為他記錄留言。
collocations: take a message for someone（為某人紀錄留言）

words.definition: 拆開；仔細檢查，仔細分析
words.example_en: Engineers took apart the machine to locate the broken component.
words.example_zh: 工程師們拆開了機器以找到損壞的零件。

words.example_en: The local utility provider announced scheduled maintenance for Sunday.
words.example_zh: 當地公共服務供應業者宣布週日進行排定維護。
collocations: electric utility provider（電力供應業者）

words.example_en: Data analysis is an acquired skill that improves with practice.
words.example_zh: 數據分析是一項可透過練習不斷提升的後天習得技能。
collocations: acquired taste（後天培養的興趣/偏好）

words.example_en: Companies must adapt quickly to changing consumer preferences.
words.example_zh: 公司必須快速適應不斷變化的消費者偏好。
collocations: adapt to market conditions（適應市場狀況）

words.example_en: The HR coordinator will administer the online employee satisfaction survey.
words.example_zh: 人資協調員將管理線上員工滿意度調查。

words.example_en: She was hired to perform routine clerical duties in the accounting office.
words.example_zh: 她獲聘在會計辦公室執行日常事務性工作。

words.example_en: The audit report provided conclusive evidence of financial mismanagement.
words.example_zh: 審計報告提供了財務管理不善的確實證據。

words.example_en: Please delete outdated files from the shared cloud folder to save space.
words.example_zh: 請從共享雲端資料夾中刪除過時文件以節省空間。

words.example_en: The magazine board approved the new editorial guidelines for publication.
words.example_zh: 雜誌董事會批准了出版的新編輯指南。

words.example_en: The customer service team faced endless complaints during the server outage.
words.example_zh: 伺服器中斷期間，客服團隊面臨無休止的投訴。

words.example_en: The software is user-friendly; furthermore, it reduces processing time.
words.example_zh: 這套軟體操作簡易；此外，它還能減少處理時間。

words.example_en: The deputy director will lead meetings in the CEO's absence.
words.example_zh: 執行長不在時，副總監將主持會議。
collocations: in the absence of（缺乏/不在時）

words.example_en: He assured his supervisor that the formatting error was not made on purpose.
words.example_zh: 他向主管保證，排版錯誤絕非故意造成的。
collocations: do something on purpose（故意做某事）

words.example_en: The company plans to open three new overseas branches in Europe.
words.example_zh: 該公司計劃在歐洲開設三家新的海外分公司。

words.example_en: Clients perceive our brand as reliable and innovative.
words.example_zh: 客戶將我們的品牌視為可靠且具創新性的。

words.definition: 提醒者，做為提醒的事物
words.example_en: The system sends an automated reminder email two days before the meeting.
words.example_zh: 系統會在會議前兩天發送自動提醒郵件。

words.example_en: Roughly fifty corporate clients attended the annual product showcase.
words.example_zh: 大約有五十家企業客戶參加了年度產品展示會。

words.example_en: Our support team strives to resolve client issues within twenty-four hours.
words.example_zh: 我們的支援團隊致力於在二十四小時內解決客戶問題。

words.example_en: The manual needs to be translated into three languages for international users.
words.example_zh: 說明書需要翻譯成三種語言供國際使用者閱讀。
collocations: translate A into B（將 A 翻譯成 B）

words.example_en: Executives gathered in the main boardroom to discuss the merger.
words.example_zh: 高管們聚集在主董事會會議室討論合併事宜。

words.example_en: All final candidates must attend the second-round interview in person.
words.example_zh: 所有最終候選人必須親自參加第二輪面試。

words.example_en: The registration fee covers all event materials, including lunch.
words.example_zh: 報名費涵蓋所有活動資料，包括午餐。
collocations: including but not limited to（包括但不限於）

words.example_en: The train arrived right on time according to the official schedule.
words.example_zh: 火車根據官方時刻表準時到達。

words.example_en: System administrators acted calmly to prevent widespread panic during the outage.
words.example_zh: 系統管理員冷靜行動，以防止中斷期間引發大範圍恐慌。

words.example_en: The accounting office sent a reminder regarding the past due payment.
words.example_zh: 會計辦公室就過期未付的款項發送了提醒。

words.example_en: The design team put forward several new concepts for the advertising campaign.
words.example_zh: 設計團隊為廣告活動提出了幾個新概念。
collocations: put forward a proposal（提出提案）

words.example_en: Industry experts regard this company as an innovator in clean technology.
words.example_zh: 產業專家認為這家公司是清潔技術領域的創新者。

words.example_en: The manager promised to return her call before the end of the day.
words.example_zh: 經理承諾在今天結束前給她回電話。
collocations: return a call promptly（及時回電話）

words.example_en: She manages secretarial support for three executive directors.
words.example_zh: 她負責為三位執行董事提供秘書支援。

words.example_en: He was asked to take charge of the new client onboarding process.
words.example_zh: 他被要求負責新客戶的入職整合流程。
collocations: take charge of a project（負責專案）

words.example_en: Senior managers are willing to take on responsibility for complex decisions.
words.example_zh: 高階經理願意對複雜的決定承擔責任。
collocations: take on more responsibility（承擔更多責任）

words.example_en: The entire team threw their effort into completing the proposal on time.
words.example_zh: 整個團隊盡最大努力準時完成提案。
collocations: throw effort into research（致力於研究）

words.example_en: Clerks were instructed to arrange items on the shelf neatly before opening.
words.example_zh: 店員接到指示開店前要將物品整齊擺放在架上。
collocations: neatly arrange items（整齊排列物品）

words.example_en: If you are unwell, please call in sick before eight in the morning.
words.example_zh: 如果您身體不適，請在早上八點前打電話請病假。
collocations: call in sick to HR（向人資請病假）

words.example_en: Could you please cover my shift on Friday while I attend a seminar?
words.example_zh: 我參加研討會期間，你能幫我代週五的班嗎？
collocations: ask someone to cover a shift（請某人代班）

words.example_en: The chief operating officer manages the day-to-day operations of the plant.
words.example_zh: 營運長管理工廠的日常營運。
collocations: manage day-to-day operations（管理日常營運）

words.example_en: The budget adjustment is fully in line with corporate strategic priorities.
words.example_zh: 預算調整完全符合公司戰略優先事項。
collocations: in line with market trends（符合市場趨勢）

words.example_en: The CEO will officiate at the grand opening ceremony of the new headquarters.
words.example_zh: 執行長將主持新總部的盛大開幕典禮。
collocations: officiate at a ceremony（主持典禮/執行職務）

words.definition: 保留的，（電話）等待通話的
words.example_en: Please stay on hold while I transfer your call to customer support.
words.example_zh: 在我將您的電話轉接到客戶支援部門時，請稍候。
collocations: put a project on hold（擱置計畫）
hold the line / stay on hold（電話稍候）

words.example_en: After getting his morning coffee, he set down to work immediately.
words.example_zh: 喝完早晨咖啡後，他立即開始工作。
collocations: set down to work on a task（著手工作）

words.example_en: Coffee helps night shift workers stay awake during long monitoring hours.
words.example_zh: 咖啡有助於夜班工人在漫長監控時間內保持清醒。
collocations: struggle to stay awake（掙扎著保持清醒）

words.example_en: Important blueprints were strew across the table during the brainstorming session.
words.example_zh: 腦力激盪期間，重要的藍圖散落放在桌上。

words.example_en: Artificial intelligence is expected to take the place of repetitive manual tasks.
words.example_zh: 人工智慧預計將取代重複性的手工任務。
collocations: take the place of traditional methods（取代傳統方法）

words.example_en: Team members take turns presenting weekly status reports.
words.example_zh: 團隊成員輪流發表每週狀態報告。

words.example_en: Due to component shortages, the assembly line is running behind schedule.
words.example_zh: 由於零件短缺，組裝線進度落後。
collocations: fall behind schedule（落後於預定進度）

words.example_en: The manager asked her to condense the fifty-page report into a executive summary.
words.example_zh: 經理要求她將五十頁的報告濃縮成一份高階摘要。

words.example_en: I will call the supplier tomorrow to follow up on the status of our order.
words.example_zh: 我明天會打給供應商追蹤我們訂單的狀態。
collocations: follow up on a request（追蹤一項請求）

words.example_en: All contract modifications must be submitted and confirmed in writing.
words.example_zh: 所有合約修改都必須以書面形式提交並確認。
collocations: confirm in writing（以書面方式確認）

words.example_en: The campaign helped popularize sustainable energy solutions among homeowners.
words.example_zh: 該活動有助於在屋主中普及永續能源解決方案。

words.example_en: Setting clear daily goals allows employees to work more productively.
words.example_zh: 設定明確的日常目標能讓員工更有生產力地工作。
collocations: work productively（高效富有成效地工作）

words.example_en: The CEO expressed deep sincerity in his apology for the service disruption.
words.example_zh: 執行長對服務中斷的致歉表達了深深的真誠。
collocations: with deep sincerity（懷著深切真誠）

words.example_en: Optimizing resource utilization is essential for reducing manufacturing waste.
words.example_zh: 優化資源利用率對於減少製造浪費至關重要。

words.example_en: She oversees administrative duties, including scheduling and record keeping.
words.example_zh: 她負責監督行政職責，包括日程安排和紀錄保持。

words.example_en: Our research laboratory is affiliated with a renowned global institute.
words.example_zh: 我們的研究實驗室隸屬於一家知名的全球機構。
collocations: be closely affiliated with（與……緊密隸屬/相關）

words.example_en: The multinational conglomerate operates across technology, energy, and retail.
words.example_zh: 該跨國企業集團業務橫跨科技、能源及零售等領域。

words.example_en: Failure to make payments on time will cause the borrower to default on the loan.
words.example_zh: 未能按時還款將導致借款人對該筆貸款違約。
collocations: default on a loan（貸款違約）

words.example_en: Management briefed the team regarding the impending corporate restructuring.
words.example_zh: 管理層就即將到來的公司重組向團隊進行了簡報。

words.example_en: The CEO has always been a strong proponent of workplace diversity.
words.example_zh: 執行長一直是職場多元化的強烈支持者。
collocations: strong proponent of（……的強烈擁護者）

words.example_en: The proprietor of the boutique hotel introduced several eco-friendly policies.
words.example_zh: 這家精品飯店的所有權人推行了多項環保政策。

words.example_en: Engineers conducted a site inspection before starting foundation work.
words.example_zh: 工程師在開始地基工程之前進行了實地視察。
collocations: conduct a site inspection（進行實地勘查）

words.example_en: A good manager delegates authority effectively to his subordinates.
words.example_zh: 一位優秀的經理人能有效授權給其下屬。

words.example_en: The parent company established a European subsidiary in Germany.
words.example_zh: 母公司在德國成立了一家歐洲子公司。

words.example_en: Employees are encouraged to take initiative in improving daily workflow.
words.example_zh: 鼓勵員工在改進日常工作流程方面主動帶頭。
collocations: take initiative to do（主動帶頭做……）

words.example_en: Many tech professionals prefer to telecommute at least two days a week.
words.example_zh: 許多科技專業人士傾向於每週至少遠距工作兩天。
collocations: telecommute from home（在家遠距工作）

topic_title: 職場日常與業務執行 (二)
description: 包含專案推進、跨部門溝通與工作效率提升相關詞彙

words.example_en: The manager warned the staff about lax security measures in the office.
words.example_zh: 經理警告員工注意辦公室內鬆懈的安全措施。

words.example_en: Employees who procrastinate on critical tasks risk missing project deadlines.
words.example_zh: 在關鍵任務上拖延的員工面臨錯過專案截止日期的風險。

words.example_en: Through their combined efforts, the two engineering teams solved the system bug.
words.example_zh: 透過這兩個工程團隊的共同努力，他們解決了系統漏洞。

words.example_en: Clear communication helps teams accomplish project goals more efficiently.
words.example_zh: 清晰的溝通有助於團隊更有效率地達成專案目標。

words.example_en: Several engineers voluntarily stayed late to help resolve the server crisis.
words.example_zh: 幾位工程師自願留下來加班以協助解決伺服器危機。

words.example_en: The research team will undertake a comprehensive market study next month.
words.example_zh: 研究團隊將於下個月從事一項全面的市場研究。

words.definition: 假定，以為；承擔（責任、角色）
words.example_en: She will assume the role of interim director until a permanent replacement is found.
words.example_zh: 在找到永久替代人選之前，她將承擔代理總監的角色。

words.example_en: Remote workers occasionally visit the head office for team-building sessions.
words.example_zh: 遠距工作人員偶爾會造訪總公司參加團隊建立活動。

words.example_en: The company rewards full-time employees with annual profit-sharing bonuses.
words.example_zh: 該公司以年度利潤分紅獎金獎勵全職員工。

words.example_en: An administrative staff member was assigned to assist with event preparations.
words.example_zh: 已指派一名行政人員協助活動準備工作。
collocations: assist someone in doing（協助某人做……）

words.example_en: Clients are highly satisfied with the prompt customer service they received.
words.example_zh: 客戶對他們所獲得的迅速客服感到非常滿意。

words.example_en: The representative handled the customer's complaint in a polite manner.
words.example_zh: 代表以禮貌的態度處理了客戶的投訴。
collocations: in a professional manner（以專業的方式）

words.example_en: The project manager is responsible for keeping the development schedule on track.
words.example_zh: 專案經理負責保持開發進度按計劃進行。
collocations: hold A responsible for B（讓 A 對 B 負責）

words.example_en: The HR department will conduct an internal investigation regarding the policy leak.
words.example_zh: 人力資源部將針對政策洩漏事件進行內部調查。

words.example_en: New staff members usually take a few weeks to adjust to the corporate culture.
words.example_zh: 新員工通常需要幾週時間來適應企業文化。
collocations: adjust A to B（使 A 適應/調整為 B）

words.example_en: All authorized personnel must scan their badges before entering the facility.
words.example_zh: 所有經授權的人員在進入設施前必須掃描識別證。

words.example_en: Both parties agreed on the final terms of the commercial contract.
words.example_zh: 雙方就商業合約的最終條款達成了一致。
collocations: agree to（贊成/同意提案條款）

words.example_en: The team leader will supervise the installation of the new server rack.
words.example_zh: 團隊領導將監督新伺服器機架的安裝。

words.example_en: Maintaining healthy relationships with coworkers fosters a positive work environment.
words.example_zh: 與同事保持良好的關係有助於營造積極的工作環境。

words.definition: 引導，指揮，指導 / 直接的
words.example_en: The receptionist will direct visitors to the second-floor conference room.
words.example_zh: 接待員將引導訪客前往二樓的會議室。
collocations: direct A to B（引導 A 到 B）

words.example_en: Salary information must be kept strictly confidential within the HR portal.
words.example_zh: 薪資資訊在人資門戶網站內必須嚴格保密。

words.example_en: The manager will assign specific tasks to team members based on their skills.
words.example_zh: 經理將根據團隊成員的技能向他們指派具體任務。

words.example_en: Our firm is a leading provider of enterprise cloud management software.
words.example_zh: 我們公司是企業雲端管理軟體的領先供應商。

words.example_en: An official written notice is required for formal contract termination.
words.example_zh: 正式終止合約需要官方書面通知。

words.example_en: The executive was removed from his post following the financial scandal.
words.example_zh: 該主管在財務醜聞爆發後被免去職務。
collocations: remove A from B（把 A 從 B 去除/免職）

words.example_en: The research team will collect user feedback to improve system design.
words.example_zh: 研究團隊將收集使用者回饋以改進系統設計。

words.example_en: The event manager will coordinate with vendors to ensure smooth setup.
words.example_zh: 活動經理將與廠商協調以確保佈置順利進行。

words.example_en: He hardly had time to finish lunch due to back-to-back meetings.
words.example_zh: 由於接連不斷的會議，他幾乎沒有時間吃完午餐。

words.example_en: The presentation was too abstract; the client wanted concrete project examples.
words.example_zh: 這份簡報太抽象了；客戶想要具體的專案範例。

words.definition: 通訊錄；工商名錄；電話簿
words.example_en: You can find employee extension numbers in the corporate internal directory.
words.example_zh: 您可以在公司內部通訊錄中找到員工分機號碼。

words.example_en: Department heads will be held accountable for any budget overruns.
words.example_zh: 部門主管將對任何預算超支負責。
collocations: be accountable for A（對 A 負有責任）
hold A accountable for B（讓 A 對 B 負責）
be accountable to A（對 A 有說明義務）

words.example_en: All reference manuals were arranged neatly in the office bookcase.
words.example_zh: 所有參考手冊都整齊地排列在辦公室書櫥裡。

words.example_en: Please put the training binders back on the top bookshelf after use.
words.example_zh: 使用後請將培訓資料夾放回最上層的書架上。

words.example_en: In case of a system malfunction, please notify the IT desk immediately.
words.example_zh: 如果發生系統故障，請立即通知 IT 服務台。

words.example_en: All branch budget requests must be approved by the central office.
words.example_zh: 所有分行的預算申請都必須獲得中央辦公室的批准。

words.example_en: The administrative clerk is fixing a paper jam in the copy machine.
words.example_zh: 行政文員正在排除影印機的卡紙故障。
collocations: operate a copy machine（操作影印機）

words.example_en: Please send a signed copy of the contract via fax before five o'clock.
words.example_zh: 請在五點前透過傳真發送一份簽署好的合約副本。

words.example_en: Organize all client receipts into a labeled file folder.
words.example_zh: 將所有客戶收據整理到貼有標籤的資料夾中。

words.example_en: The receptionist will greet visitors at the front entrance.
words.example_zh: 接待員將在大門入口處迎接訪客。

words.example_en: His handwriting on the memo was difficult for the staff to read.
words.example_zh: 他在備忘錄上的字跡讓員工難以辨認。

words.example_en: Enter your four-digit passkey on the security keypad to open the door.
words.example_zh: 在安全數字鍵盤上輸入您的四位數密碼以開門。

words.example_en: Please use a utility knife to open the heavy cardboard boxes in the mailroom.
words.example_zh: 請使用美工刀打開郵件室裡的大厚紙箱。

words.example_en: Employees must log on to the corporate portal to check their work schedules.
words.example_zh: 員工必須登入公司入口網站以查看其工作時程表。
collocations: log on to system（登入系統）

words.definition: 網路上的 / 在網路上
words.example_en: You can complete your training modules online at your own pace.
words.example_zh: 您可以在網路上按照自己的步調完成培訓模組。

words.example_en: The photocopier in the main hallway is scheduled for maintenance tomorrow.
words.example_zh: 主走廊上的影印機預計明天進行維護。

words.example_en: Please make a photocopy of your identification badge for HR records.
words.example_zh: 請將您的識別證影印一份供人資存檔。

words.example_en: I will print out the meeting agenda and distribute it to everyone.
words.example_zh: 我會將會議議程列印出來並分發給每個人。

words.example_en: The manager asked the assistant to process the urgent invoice right away.
words.example_zh: 經理要求助理立即處理這張緊急發票。

words.example_en: Could you please spell your last name for the registration record?
words.example_zh: 能否請您拼出您的姓氏以進行登記？

words.example_en: Shipping staff will wrap fragile items securely before transport.
words.example_zh: 運輸人員會在運輸前將易碎物品妥善包裝。
collocations: wrap up a project（結束專案）

words.example_en: Please fold the letters neatly before placing them in the envelopes.
words.example_zh: 放入信封前，請將信件整齊摺疊。

words.example_en: This strategy carries the least risk among all presented options.
words.example_zh: 在所有提出的方案中，這個策略承擔的風險最小。

words.example_en: All official papers related to the transaction must be filed safely.
words.example_zh: 與交易相關的所有官方文件都必須妥善歸檔。

words.example_en: Strategic planning is vital for long-term business expansion.
words.example_zh: 戰略規劃對於長期業務擴張至關重要。

words.example_en: The HR coordinator will post the internal job openings on the intranet.
words.example_zh: 人資協調員將在內部網路上公布內部職缺。

words.example_en: Press the button on the left to start the automatic scanning process.
words.example_zh: 按下左邊的按鈕以啟動自動掃描程序。
collocations: press the emergency button（按下緊急按鈕）

words.example_en: The IT team rebooted the main file server to resolve network issues.
words.example_zh: IT 團隊重啟了主檔案伺服器以解決網路問題。

words.example_en: The marketing team prepared promotional flyers for the grand store opening.
words.example_zh: 行銷團隊為盛大店面開幕準備了宣傳單。
collocations: grand store opening（盛大門市開幕）

words.example_en: The team lead assigned routine daily tasks to each team member.
words.example_zh: 團隊領導將日常任務分派給每位團隊成員。

words.example_en: The management was highly satisfied with the quarterly sales results.
words.example_zh: 管理層對季度銷售結果感到非常滿意。
collocations: be satisfied with results（對結果感到滿意）

words.example_en: Please be seated promptly as the presentation is about to begin.
words.example_zh: 簡報即將開始，請儘快入座。

words.example_en: The headquarters is surrounded by extensive green spaces.
words.example_zh: 總部大樓被廣闊的綠地所圍繞。
collocations: be surrounded by parks（被公園環繞）

words.definition: 業務上認識的人或公司
words.example_en: He maintained strong relationships with key business contacts overseas.
words.example_zh: 他與海外關鍵的業務聯絡人保持著良好的關係。
