collocations: expand business contacts（拓展業務人脈）

words.example_en: The chairperson called the annual general shareholder meeting to order.
words.example_zh: 主席宣布年度股東常會正式開始。

words.example_en: The copy editor corrected several grammar errors in the manuscript.
words.example_zh: 文字編輯更正了稿件中的幾處語法錯誤。
collocations: senior copy editor（資深文字編輯）

words.example_en: New trainees were thrown into the deep end during their first week.
words.example_zh: 新受訓者在第一週就被推入深水區（直接接受嚴苛考驗）。
collocations: jump in the deep end（直接挑戰難關）

words.example_en: Please print all meeting handouts on double-sided paper to save resources.
words.example_zh: 請將所有會議講義進行雙面列印以節省資源。

words.example_en: Important office keys are locked in the top desk drawer.
words.example_zh: 重要的辦公室鑰匙被鎖在上層桌子抽屜裡。

words.example_en: You must get the manager's approval before booking travel tickets.
words.example_zh: 在訂差旅機票前，您必須取得經理的批准。
collocations: get final approval（獲得最終批准）

words.example_en: The project reached its halfway point ahead of schedule.
words.example_zh: 該專案提前達到了中途里程碑。

words.example_en: The outgoing manager will hand over all responsibilities next week.
words.example_zh: 即將離任的經理將於下週移交所有職責。

words.example_en: Unprocessed applications were stacked neatly in a pile on the desk.
words.example_zh: 未處理的申請表在桌上整齊地堆成一堆。
collocations: stacked in a pile（堆成一堆）

words.example_en: Although we lost a client, it could have been worse given the market conditions.
words.example_zh: 儘管我們失去了一位客戶，但考量到市場狀況，情況原本可能會更糟。
collocations: It could have been worse（事情算是不幸中的大幸）

words.example_en: The shipment arrived just in time for the product launch.
words.example_zh: 貨物正好及時到達以趕上產品發布會。
collocations: just in time delivery（及時生產/準時交貨制度）

words.example_en: Digital literacy is a core requirement for all modern office jobs.
words.example_zh: 數位應用讀寫能力是所有現代辦公室工作的核心要求。

words.example_en: Please do not litter in the corporate park courtyard.
words.example_zh: 請勿在企業園區中庭亂丟垃圾。

words.example_en: The hiring panel will make a selection from the top candidates.
words.example_zh: 面試小組將從頂尖候選人中做出選擇。
collocations: make a final selection（做出最終選擇）

words.example_en: We rearranged the office furniture to make room for new computer equipment.
words.example_zh: 我們重新排列了辦公室家具，以給新的電腦設備騰出空間。
collocations: make room for expansion（為擴建騰出空間）

words.example_en: The printer on the second floor is currently out of paper.
words.example_zh: 二樓的印表機目前紙張用完了。
collocations: run out of paper（紙張用光）

words.example_en: Please raise your hand if you have any questions during the presentation.
words.example_zh: 簡報期間如有任何問題，請舉手。
collocations: raise one's hand to ask（舉手發問）

words.example_en: Users should report a problem through the online helpdesk system.
words.example_zh: 使用者應透過線上客服系統回報問題。
collocations: report a technical problem（回報技術問題）

words.example_en: The assistant was asked to sort the incoming mail by department.
words.example_zh: 助理被要求按部門將收到的郵件進行分類。

words.example_en: Office stationery supplies can be requested from the admin department.
words.example_zh: 可向行政部門申請辦公文具用品。

words.example_en: Let me take another look at the financial figures before we finalize the budget.
words.example_zh: 在我們敲定預算前，讓我再看一次財務數據。
collocations: take another look at（重新審視……）

words.example_en: Please take A out of the storage room and bring it to the lobby.
words.example_zh: 請將 A 從儲藏室拿出並帶到大廳。
collocations: take out a file（拿出檔案）

words.example_en: An antique typewriter was displayed in the company's historical museum.
words.example_zh: 一台古董打字機在公司的歷史博物館展出。

words.example_en: Trainees were asked to work in groups during the workshop session.
words.example_zh: 受訓者被要求在工作坊期間分組進行工作。
collocations: work in small groups（小組合作）

words.example_en: The hotel room provided a writing pad and a pen on the desk.
words.example_zh: 飯店房間的桌上提供了一本便籤簿和一支筆。

words.example_en: The launch of the new smartphone was met with high market anticipation.
words.example_zh: 這款新智慧型手機的發布伴隨著很高的市場期待。

words.example_en: The corporate fleet includes several hybrid automobile models.
words.example_zh: 公司車隊包括幾款油電混合汽車車型。

words.example_en: Employees were asked to do a quick survey on workplace satisfaction.
words.example_zh: 員工被要求做一份關於職場滿意度的快速調查。
collocations: be asked to submit（被要求提交……）

words.example_en: All overtime hours worked will be paid for in the next salary cycle.
words.example_zh: 所有加班時數將在下一個薪資週期獲得報酬。
collocations: be paid for overtime（獲得加班費）

words.example_en: Only senior engineers are qualified for the technical lead position.
words.example_zh: 只有資深工程師才有資格擔任技術負責人職位。
collocations: be fully qualified for（完全具備……資格）

words.example_en: Employees are permitted to wear casual attire on Fridays.
words.example_zh: 員工獲准在週五穿著休閒服裝。

words.definition: 起草（計畫、文件等） / 草案，草稿
words.example_en: The legal counsel will draft the preliminary agreement by tomorrow.
words.example_zh: 法律顧問將在明天前起草初步協議。

words.example_en: She drew on her years of field experience to solve the technical issue.
words.example_zh: 她利用自己多年的現場經驗解決了這項技術問題。

words.definition: 理由，藉口 / 原諒，寬恕
words.example_en: There is no valid excuse for failing to follow safety protocols.
words.example_zh: 沒有任何合法的藉口可以不遵守安全協定。

words.example_en: The head office coordinates global marketing initiatives across regions.
words.example_zh: 總公司負責協調各區域的全球行銷計畫。

words.example_en: The factory increased inventory in anticipation of high holiday demand.
words.example_zh: 工廠預料到假期的強勁需求而增加了庫存。
collocations: in anticipation of growth（預期增長）

words.example_en: In light of recent budget constraints, we must postpone new hires.
words.example_zh: 鑑於近期的預算限制，我們必須推遲招募新人。
collocations: in light of recent events（鑑於近期的事件）

words.example_en: Technicians use precise measuring instruments during factory testing.
words.example_zh: 技術人員在工廠測試期間使用精密的測量器具。

words.example_en: The new software is popularly known for its fast execution speed.
words.example_zh: 這款新軟體因其極快的執行速度而廣為人知。

words.example_en: Please contact HR if you have any questions regarding your pension plan.
words.example_zh: 如果您有關於退休金計畫的任何問題，請聯絡人資。

words.example_en: Servers are routinely backed up every midnight to safeguard data.
words.example_zh: 伺服器每天午夜常規進行備份以保護數據。

words.definition: 固定的；常設的 / 地位，聲望
words.example_en: We have a standing committee that oversees health and safety standards.
words.example_zh: 我們有一個負責監督健康與安全標準的常設委員會。

words.example_en: The report includes supplementary data tables in the appendix.
words.example_zh: 該報告在附錄中包含補充數據表。

words.example_en: Staff may need to work overtime during the peak tax filing season.
words.example_zh: 員工在報稅高峰期可能需要加班。
collocations: pay for working overtime（支付加班費）

words.example_en: Maintaining a respectful workplace environment is mandatory for all staff.
words.example_zh: 保持相互尊重的職場環境是所有員工的義務。

words.example_en: He was appointed as the acting manager while the director was on leave.
words.example_zh: 總監休假期間，他被任命為代理經理。

words.example_en: The quarterly market report was full of valuable consumer insights.
words.example_zh: 季度市場報告充滿了寶貴的消費者洞察。
collocations: be full of potential（充滿潛力）

words.definition: 把 A 轉換成 B
words.example_en: The system will automatically convert image files to PDF format.
words.example_zh: 系統會自動將圖檔轉換為 PDF 格式。
collocations: convert files to PDF（將檔案轉為 PDF）

words.example_en: You can count on our support team to respond within an hour.
words.example_zh: 您可以指望我們的支援團隊在一小時內做出回應。
collocations: count on someone for help（指望某人尋求幫助）

words.example_en: Please fill the requisition order with the necessary product details.
words.example_zh: 請在請購單中填滿必要的產品細節。
collocations: fill with details（填寫詳細內容）

words.example_en: The new employee gets along well with everyone in the team.
words.example_zh: 新員工與團隊中的每個人都相處得很好。
collocations: get along well with colleagues（與同事相處融洽）

words.example_en: Please watch your footing as you go down the steps to the basement.
words.example_zh: 走下樓梯前往地下室時請注意腳下。
collocations: carefully go down the steps（小心走下樓梯）

words.example_en: Continuous innovation is widely regarded as the key to success.
words.example_zh: 持續創新被廣泛認為是成功的關鍵。

words.example_en: Professional managers should never lose their temper during client negotiations.
words.example_zh: 專業經理人在客戶談判期間絕不應發脾氣。

words.example_en: Please make a copy of the presentation slides for each participant.
words.example_zh: 請為每位參會者影印一份簡報簡報。
collocations: make a quick copy（快速影印）

words.example_en: Don't obsess about minor setbacks; focus on the broader project vision.
words.example_zh: 不要對小挫折念念不忘；專注於更廣闊的專案願景。
collocations: obsess about details（過度執著於細節）

words.example_en: All overtime hours must be pre-approved by department supervisors.
words.example_zh: 所有加班時數必須事先獲得部門主管的批准。
collocations: log overtime hours（記錄加班時數）

words.example_en: Employees should keep their personal effects inside their assigned lockers.
words.example_zh: 員工應將個人物品放在指派給他們的寄物櫃內。
collocations: safeguard personal effects（保管個人物品）

words.example_en: The annual alumni reunion will take place at the main auditorium.
words.example_zh: 年度校友重聚活動將在大禮堂舉行。

words.example_en: Our top sales representative closed three major corporate accounts this month.
words.example_zh: 我們頂尖的銷售代表本月簽下了三個重大企業客戶。
collocations: experienced sales representative（經驗豐富的銷售代表）

words.definition: 無縫的，沒有接續問題的
words.example_en: The system upgrade ensures a seamless transition for all database users.
words.example_zh: 系統升級確保了所有資料庫使用者的無縫轉接。

words.example_en: Please submit your completed expense form to the accounting department.
words.example_zh: 請將填妥的報銷單提交給會計部門。
collocations: submit documents to HR（向人資提交文件）

words.example_en: The engineering team succeeded in launching the app three weeks early.
words.example_zh: 工程團隊成功地提早三週上線了該應用程式。
collocations: succeed in obtaining approval（成功獲得批准）

words.example_en: Manual data entry is a highly time-consuming administrative process.
words.example_zh: 手動資料輸入是一項非常耗時的行政流程。

words.example_en: Accurate bookkeeping is essential for transparent corporate financial reporting.
words.example_zh: 準確的簿記對於透明的公司財務報告至關重要。

words.example_en: The HR department has its hands full processing all new year applications.
words.example_zh: 人力資源部正忙於處理所有新年申請，非常忙碌。
collocations: have one's hands full with work（忙於工作）

words.example_en: Press '9' on your desk phone to make an outside call.
words.example_zh: 在桌上電話上按『9』以撥打外線電話。
collocations: dial 9 to make an outside call（撥 9 打外線）

words.example_en: Employee performance bonuses serve as strong motivation for sales teams.
words.example_zh: 員工績效獎金是銷售團隊強大的工作動機。

words.example_en: The newly listed company saw a sharp rise in its stock price.
words.example_zh: 這家新上市/新列入的公司股價大幅上漲。

words.definition: 優先處理，按先後順序處理
words.example_en: Project managers must prioritize urgent tasks to keep project goals on track.
words.example_zh: 專案經理必須優先處理緊急任務以維持專案目標進度。

words.definition: 彼此隔著一個座位坐，交互入座
words.example_en: Audience members were asked to sit in alternate seats for social distancing.
words.example_zh: 聽眾被要求交錯入座以保持社交距離。
collocations: sit in alternate seats in auditorium（禮堂內交錯入座）

words.example_en: Access to server logs requires formal written authorization from the IT head.
words.example_zh: 存取伺服器紀錄需要 IT 主管的正式書面授權。
collocations: obtain written authorization（取得書面授權）

words.example_en: Using corporate branding materials requires prior written consent.
words.example_zh: 使用公司品牌標誌資料需要事先取得書面同意。
collocations: prior written consent（事先書面同意）

words.example_en: He made a useful business acquaintance during the international trade expo.
words.example_zh: 他在國際貿易博覽會期間結識了一位有用的業務相識之人。

words.example_en: Please verify the exact dimensions of the office desk before ordering.
words.example_zh: 訂購前請確認辦公桌的確切尺寸。

words.definition: 指導的，指揮的 / 指令
words.example_en: The CEO issued a firm directive concerning cost-cutting measures.
words.example_zh: 執行長就削減成本措施發布了明確指令。

words.example_en: Our high-end services cater to the needs of discerning corporate clients.
words.example_zh: 我們的高端服務迎合了具備敏銳識別力的企業客戶需求。

words.example_en: The newly renovated boardroom was elegantly furnished.
words.example_zh: 新翻修的董事會會議室佈置得非常優雅。

words.example_en: An expectant crowd gathered to hear the CEO's annual address.
words.example_zh: 充滿期待的人群聚集在一起聆聽執行長的年度演說。

words.example_en: Her years of field experience proved invaluable to the research team.
words.example_zh: 她多年的現場經驗被證明對研究團隊來說是極其寶貴的。

words.example_en: Innovative technological solutions will propel our business ahead of competitors.
words.example_zh: 創新的技術解決方案將推動我們的業務超越競爭者。

words.example_en: The sudden realization of market changes led to a strategic shift.
words.example_zh: 對市場變化的突然領悟導致了戰略上的轉變。

words.example_en: Passengers are asked not to recline their seats during takeoff and landing.
words.example_zh: 乘客被要求在起飛和降落期間不要起傾後靠座位。

words.example_en: The cloud server acts as a central repository for company documents.
words.example_zh: 雲端伺服器扮演著公司文件的中央貯藏庫。

words.example_en: After the conference, participants returned to their respective departments.
words.example_zh: 會議結束後，與會者返回各自的部門。

words.example_en: The team spontaneously gathered to celebrate closing the major deal.
words.example_zh: 團隊自發性地聚集在一起慶祝完成重大交易。

words.example_en: Managers should avoid spending excessive time on trivial administrative tasks.
words.example_zh: 管理者應避免在瑣碎的行政任務上花費過多時間。

words.definition: 繳交（業績、收益等的）上繳；（文件的）提出
words.example_en: Please turn in your weekly sales report before Friday noon.
words.example_zh: 請在週五中午前繳交每週銷售報告。
collocations: turn in a report（繳交報告）
turn in one's resignation（遞交辭呈）

words.example_en: The quiet ambiance of the new lounge allows staff to work comfortably.
words.example_zh: 新休息室安靜的氣氛能讓員工舒適地工作。

words.example_en: Her career aspiration is to become the chief marketing officer of the company.
words.example_zh: 她的職涯志向是成為公司的首席行銷官。

words.example_en: The team delivered a highly creditable performance despite budget constraints.
words.example_zh: 儘管面臨預算限制，團隊還是展現了值得稱讚的表現。

words.example_en: An eminent economist was invited as the keynote speaker for the forum.
words.example_zh: 一位名聲顯赫的經濟學家受邀擔任論壇的主旨演講嘉賓。

words.example_en: We will endeavor to provide the best customer service experience possible.
words.example_zh: 我們將盡力提供最佳的客戶服務體驗。

words.definition: 委託 A 處理 B
words.example_en: The CEO decided to entrust her with the critical overseas expansion project.
words.example_zh: 執行長決定將關鍵的海外擴張專案委託給她處理。
collocations: entrust A with responsibility（把責任託付給 A）

words.example_en: Employees felt on edge while waiting for the restructuring announcement.
words.example_zh: 員工在等待重組公告時感到坐立不安。
collocations: feel on edge（感到緊張坐立不安）

words.example_en: Proper mentorship helps junior developers reach their full potential quickly.
words.example_zh: 適當的指導有助於初級開發人員迅速發揮最大潛力。
collocations: reach full potential（發揮全部潛能）

topic_title: 職場日常與業務執行 (三)
description: 包含進階商務應對、問題解決與職涯專業技巧相關詞彙

words.example_en: The manager explained the details of the new safety procedure to the team.
words.example_zh: 經理向團隊說明了新安全程序的細節。
collocations: explain A to B（向 B 說明 A）

words.example_en: The document folder contains confidential financial reports from last year.
words.example_zh: 該文件夾包含去年的機密財務報告。

words.example_en: The assistant will compile customer feedback into a comprehensive report.
words.example_zh: 助理將把客戶回饋匯整成一份完整的報告。

words.example_en: Subsequent investigations revealed several errors in the accounting system.
words.example_zh: 隨後的調查揭露了會計系統中的幾處錯誤。

words.example_en: The Director gave a brief overview of the project roadmap during the meeting.
words.example_zh: 總監在會議期間對專案路線圖進行了簡短的概要說明。
collocations: give an overview of（提供……的概要）

words.example_en: We are looking for a reliable internet service provider for our new branch office.
words.example_zh: 我們正在為我們的新分公司尋找一家可靠的網路服務供應商。

words.definition: 問題，事情 / 有關係，要緊
words.example_en: Please deal with personal matters outside of working hours.
words.example_zh: 請在工作時間以外處理個人事務。
collocations: as a matter of fact（事實上）

words.example_en: She was hired for her technical expertise in database administration.
words.example_zh: 她因在資料庫管理方面的技術專長而被聘用。
collocations: have expertise in（在……方面擁有專業知識）

words.example_en: The representative will demonstrate how to operate the new equipment.
words.example_zh: 代表將示範如何操作這台新設備。

words.example_en: Audits will continue throughout the remainder of the month.
words.example_zh: 審計將在這個月剩餘的時間裡繼續進行。
collocations: throughout the remainder of（在……剩餘的時間裡）

words.example_en: Clear goals are essential to the success of any commercial project.
words.example_zh: 明確的目標對於任何商業專案的成功都是不可或缺的。

words.example_en: The project tasks were divided equally among the team members.
words.example_zh: 專案任務被平均分給了團隊成員。
collocations: divide A into B（將 A 分分成 B）

words.example_en: The new manager had a major impact on team productivity.
words.example_zh: 新經理對團隊的生產力產生了重大影響。

words.example_en: Government officials will inspect the factory's compliance with safety regulations.
words.example_zh: 政府官員將檢查工廠對安全法規的遵守情況。

words.example_en: The memo clarified several points regarding the company's new remote work policy.
words.example_zh: 該備忘錄澄清了關於公司新遠距工作政策的幾點疑問。

words.definition: 面對（問題等）；面向 / 臉
words.example_en: The retail industry faces fierce competition from online shopping platforms.
words.example_zh: 零售業面臨來自網路購物平台的激烈競爭。

words.definition: 跟隨；密切注意；聽懂，了解
words.example_en: Please follow the instructions on the screen to complete registration.
words.example_zh: 請按照螢幕上的指示完成註冊。

words.example_en: Every aspect of the product design was carefully reviewed by the quality team.
words.example_zh: 產品設計的各個方面都經過品質團隊的仔細審查。

words.example_en: Apparently, Mr. Jones was not notified about the change in meeting time.
words.example_zh: 顯然，瓊斯先生沒有接到關於會議時間變更的通知。

words.example_en: Employees should be made aware of company safety protocols during orientation.
words.example_zh: 應讓員工在新人培訓期間了解公司的安全協定。

words.example_en: The accounting department worked extended hours during the annual audit.
words.example_zh: 會計部在年度審計期間延長了工作時間（加班）。
collocations: extended hours（延長的時間/加班時間）
extended lunch break（延長的午休時間）

words.example_en: An employee accidentally deleted the backup file from the server.
words.example_zh: 一名員工不小心從伺服器中刪除了備份檔案。

words.example_en: It is advisable to back up all important documents on an external drive.
words.example_zh: 將所有重要文件備份到外接硬碟上是明智的做法。
collocations: it is advisable to do（做……是明智的）

words.example_en: Management is deeply concerned about data security in cloud storage.
words.example_zh: 管理層對雲端儲存中的數據安全感到非常擔心。

words.example_en: The CEO spoke to shareholders about the future expansion plan.
words.example_zh: 執行長向股東講述了未來的擴張計劃。

words.example_en: The consultant left his briefcase in the main conference room.
words.example_zh: 顧問把他的公事包留在主會議室裡了。

words.example_en: The regional sales director is currently in Tokyo on a business trip.
words.example_zh: 區域銷售總監目前在東京出差。
collocations: go on a business trip（去出差）
approve a business trip（批准出差）

words.example_zh: 當你完成財務報告時，請順道來我的辦公室。
collocations: come over to the office（順道來辦公室）

words.example_en: Please leave your guest pass at the reception counter upon departure.
words.example_zh: 離開時請將您的訪客證留在接待櫃台。

words.definition: 電子郵件 / 寄電子郵件

words.example_zh: 請在中午前將簽署好的合約電子郵件寄給法務部。

words.example_en: All historical personnel records are locked safely inside the filing cabinet.
words.example_zh: 所有歷史人事紀錄均妥善鎖在檔案櫃內。

words.example_en: Organize all client receipts into a designated shared cloud folder.
words.example_zh: 將所有客戶收據整理到指定的共享雲端資料夾中。

words.example_zh: 頻繁的伺服器當機一直是 IT 部門重大令人頭痛的問題。
collocations: cause a headache（引起頭痛/麻煩）

words.example_zh: 她在一間領先的財務公司獲得了有薪暑期實習機會。

words.example_en: The manager asked the design team to redo the proposal layout.
words.example_zh: 經理要求設計團隊重做提案版面。

words.example_en: Routine system checks are conducted every Sunday night to ensure reliability.
words.example_zh: 每週日晚上會進行例行系統檢查以確保可靠性。

words.example_en: Each workstation is equipped with an adjustable table lamp.
words.example_zh: 每個工作站都配備了一盞可調節的桌燈。
collocations: desk lamp / table lamp（檯燈/桌燈）

words.example_en: Thanks to your prompt assistance, we completed the audit ahead of time.
words.example_zh: 多虧你的即時協助，我們提前完成了審計。
collocations: thanks to hard work（歸功於努力工作）

words.example_en: The project coordinator released a strict timetable for the product launch.
words.example_zh: 專案協調員發布了產品發布的嚴格時程表。

words.example_en: The retail store updated its window display to feature seasonal merchandise.
words.example_zh: 該零售店更新了櫥窗展示，以打出季節性商品。
collocations: attractive window display（吸引人的櫥窗展示）

words.definition: 首要的；首席的 / 領導人；首領
words.example_en: The chief executive officer delivered the keynote address at the summit.
words.example_zh: 執行長在高峰會上發表了主旨演講。

words.example_en: Companies are legally forbidden to conceal financial losses from shareholders.
words.example_zh: 法律禁止公司向股東隱瞞財務虧損。

words.example_zh: 請確保季度發票中的所有數據皆正確無誤。

words.example_en: Economic growth in the region has boosted retail sales significantly.
words.example_zh: 該地區的經濟成長大幅推升了零售銷售額。

words.example_en: The corporation is eager to embrace digital transformation technologies.
words.example_zh: 該企業急於採納數位轉型技術。

words.example_en: The new product release resulted in higher than expected quarterly profits.
words.example_zh: 新產品發布帶來的季度利潤高於預期。

words.example_en: The annual business forum provides a platform for industry networking.
words.example_zh: 年度商業論壇為產業交流提供了一個平台。

words.example_en: We used an online videoconference instead of traveling to the branch.
words.example_zh: 我們使用了線上視訊會議，而不是出差前往分公司。

words.example_en: The company's core mission is to deliver sustainable technology solutions.
words.example_zh: 公司的核心使命是提供永續的技術解決方案。

words.example_en: Our IT department specializes in advanced software programming.
words.example_zh: 我們的 IT 部門專精於進階軟體程式設計。

words.example_en: The remaining budget will be allocated to marketing during next quarter.
words.example_zh: 剩餘預算將於下季度分配給行銷部門。

words.example_en: Do not rush the final quality check just to meet the deadline.
words.example_zh: 不要為了趕上截止日期而草率進行最終品質檢查。

words.example_en: Unfortunately, the main speaker had to cancel due to a flight delay.
words.example_zh: 不幸的是，主講人因航班延誤不得不取消行程。

words.definition: 檔案保管處，資料庫 / 存檔
words.example_en: Old tax documents were moved to the secure cloud archive.
words.example_zh: 舊的稅務文件已移至安全的雲端檔案庫。

words.example_en: Management was unwilling to compromise on product safety standards.
words.example_zh: 管理層不願意在產品安全標準上做妥協。
collocations: be unwilling to adapt（不願適應）

words.example_en: Engineers were up late resolving the critical network vulnerability.
words.example_zh: 工程師們熬夜到很晚來解決關鍵的網路漏洞。
collocations: be up late working（工作到很晚）

words.example_en: The sudden power blackout caused factory operations to halt temporarily.
words.example_zh: 突如其來的停電導致工廠營運暫時中斷。

words.example_en: The quarterly board meeting will review annual budget allocations.
words.example_zh: 季度董事會會議將審查年度預算分配。
collocations: attend a board meeting（出席董事會會議）

words.example_en: The board of directors approved the merger plan unanimously.
words.example_zh: 董事會一致通過了合併計劃。
collocations: member of the board of directors（董事會成員）

words.example_en: The interviewer crossed his arms while listening to the candidate's response.
words.example_zh: 面試官一邊雙手抱胸，一邊聆聽應徵者的回答。
collocations: stand with arms crossed（雙手抱胸站著）

words.example_en: Sales figures for the third quarter were rather depressing.
words.example_zh: 第三季度的銷售數據相當令人沮喪。

words.example_en: You can drag and drop files directly into the shared cloud folder.
words.example_zh: 您可以直接將檔案拖放至共享雲端資料夾中。

words.example_zh: 放入開窗信封前請將紙張對折。

words.example_zh: 市場趨勢的不確定性可能會使小投資者感到害怕。

words.example_zh: 儘管專案延誤，團隊還是決定堅持下去。

words.example_en: Developing long-term client relationships is crucial for business sustainability.
words.example_zh: 發展長期的客戶關係對於企業的永續經營至關重要。

words.example_en: Junior staff members look up to her for professional guidance.
words.example_zh: 初級員工尊敬她並尋求其專業指導。
collocations: look up to a mentor（尊敬導師）

words.example_zh: 主導分析師將針對進入市場戰略進行簡報發表。

words.example_en: The author had to make a revision to the draft proposal.
words.example_zh: 作者必須對提案草案進行修訂。

words.example_zh: 請仔細核對所有計算，以確保不會犯錯。
collocations: make an error in accounting（在會計上犯錯）

words.example_en: We worked overtime to ensure that we could meet the deadline.
words.example_zh: 我們加班加點以確保能夠趕上截止日期。
collocations: struggle to meet the deadline（掙扎著趕上最後期限）

words.example_en: The applicant must meet the requirements specified in the job posting.
words.example_zh: 應徵者必須符合招聘公告中指定的條件。
collocations: meet minimum requirements（符合最低要求）

words.example_en: A single technical glitch could mess up the whole event schedule.
words.example_zh: 一個小的技術故障就可能搞砸整個活動時程。
collocations: mess up a project（搞砸專案）

words.example_en: I would love to attend the seminar, but my schedule doesn't permit it.
words.example_zh: 我很想參加該研討會，但我的行程不允許。
collocations: My schedule doesn't permit it（時間抽不開）

words.example_en: There is an obvious need for improved internal communication.
words.example_zh: 顯然需要改善內部溝通。

words.example_en: Order additional office supplies such as paper clips and printer ink.
words.example_zh: 訂購額外的辦公用品，如迴紋針和印表機墨水。
collocations: order office supplies（訂購辦公用品）

words.example_en: Auditors must be careful not to overlook minor expense discrepancies.
words.example_zh: 審計師必須小心，不可忽視微小的費用差異。

words.definition: 一整夜；突然地 / 整夜的
words.example_en: The shipping company guarantees overnight delivery for all urgent packages.
words.example_zh: 該航運公司保證所有緊急包裹都能隔夜送達。
collocations: overnight delivery（隔夜送達/限時快遞）

words.example_en: Please ensure all confidential papers are locked in the cabinet before leaving.
words.example_zh: 離開前請確保所有機密文件均已鎖在櫃子裡。

words.example_en: Always proofread your business emails before clicking send.
words.example_zh: 發送商業郵件前一定要先校對。

words.definition: 重新安排（行程）；重新排列
words.example_en: We had to rearrange the meeting schedule due to the director's travel plans.
words.example_zh: 由於總監的出差計畫，我們不得不重新安排會議時間。
collocations: rearrange a schedule（重新安排日程）

words.example_en: Engineers were hired to recondition the old factory machinery.
words.example_zh: 聘請了工程師來修復舊的工廠機械。

words.word: rest one's chin on one's hand
words.example_en: She rested her chin on her hand while contemplating the complex proposal.
words.example_zh: 她在深入思考這個複雜提案時，用手托著下巴。
collocations: rest chin on hand（手托下巴思考）

words.example_en: The lab technician sat on a high wooden stool near the workbench.
words.example_zh: 實驗室技術員坐在工作台高高的木凳上。

words.definition: 工作時間記錄卡，出勤卡
words.example_en: All factory workers must punch their timecard upon entering.
words.example_zh: 所有工廠工人進入時都必須打出勤卡。

words.example_en: Please wipe the whiteboard clean after the brainstorming session.
words.example_zh: 頭腦風暴會議結束後，請將白板擦乾淨。

words.example_en: Employees who work additional hours during peak season get extra pay.
words.example_zh: 旺季期間額外加班的員工將獲得加班費。
collocations: be paid for working additional hours（獲得加班補償）

words.example_en: The plant operates three work shifts per day to maintain continuous production.
words.example_zh: 該工廠每天實施三個輪班制以保持連續生產。

words.definition: 讓人負擔很重的，煩人的
words.example_en: Excessive administrative paperwork can be burdensome for field agents.
words.example_zh: 繁重的行政文書工作對外勤人員來說可能是一負擔。

words.example_en: Please circulate the meeting minutes to all department managers.
words.example_zh: 請將會議紀錄傳閱給所有部門經理。

words.example_en: The CEO commended the engineering team for their innovative solution.
words.example_zh: 執行長稱讚了工程團隊的創新解決方案。
collocations: commend someone for（因……而稱讚某人）

words.example_en: We enjoy good company and professional atmosphere in our workplace.
words.example_zh: 我們在工作場所享有良好的夥伴關係和專業氛圍。

words.example_en: Budget restrictions should not discourage creative project proposals.
words.example_zh: 預算限制不應打消創意的專案提案。
collocations: discourage someone from doing（打消某人做……的念頭）

words.example_en: Open office layouts can sometimes create excessive noise distraction.
words.example_zh: 開放式辦公室佈局有時會造成過多的噪音干擾分心。

words.example_en: The system failure was caused by an unexpected power surge.
words.example_zh: 系統故障是由突如其來的電壓驟昇引起的。

words.definition: 接下來是～，隨之而來的是～
words.example_en: The keynote address will be followed by a short question and answer session.
words.example_zh: 主旨演講之後將是短暫的問答環節。
collocations: followed by a reception（隨後是酒會）

words.example_en: The meeting proceeded without any interruption from phone calls.
words.example_zh: 會議順利進行，未受任何電話干擾。

words.example_en: Make sure that all server files are fully backed up before midnight.
words.example_zh: 請確保所有伺服器檔案在午夜前完全備份。

words.definition: 貼錯標籤的，錯誤標示的
words.example_en: The mislabeled boxes were returned to the warehouse for sorting.
words.example_zh: 貼錯標籤的箱子被退回倉庫進行分類。

words.example_en: An observant auditor can quickly spot small errors in financial statements.
words.example_zh: 善於觀察的審計師能迅速發現財務報表中的小錯誤。

words.example_en: The sales team managed to persuade the client to sign a two-year contract.
words.example_zh: 銷售團隊成功說服客戶簽署了兩年的合約。
collocations: persuade someone to do（說服某人去做……）

words.example_en: The board approved the proposed budget for the overseas marketing campaign.
words.example_zh: 董事會批准了擬議中的海外行銷活動預算。

words.example_en: Could you rephrase your question so the technical panel can understand?
words.example_zh: 您能否換個方式表達您的問題，方便技術小組理解？
collocations: rephrase a question（換個方式問問題）

words.example_en: There was scarcely enough time to finish the project before the deadline.
words.example_zh: 在截止日期前幾乎沒有足夠的時間完成專案。

words.example_en: Please write the executive summary as concisely as possible.
words.example_zh: 請盡可能簡潔地撰寫高階執行摘要。

words.example_en: The union expressed strong disapproval of the proposed salary cuts.
words.example_zh: 工會對擬議的減薪表達了強烈的不贊成。
collocations: express disapproval of（對……表示反對/不贊成）

words.example_en: The board of directors disapproved the initial budget allocation plan.
words.example_zh: 董事會不贊成最初的預算分配計畫。

words.example_en: Could you do me a favor and review this draft before I send it?
words.example_zh: 能否幫我一個忙，在我發送這份草案前先幫我審閱一下？
collocations: do a favor for someone（幫某人忙）

words.example_en: The maintenance team did a good job repairing the server system overnight.
words.example_zh: 維修團隊連夜修復了伺服器系統，做得很好。
collocations: do a great job on（在……上表現出色）

words.example_en: It is essential to draw a distinction between urgent and important tasks.
words.example_zh: 區分緊急任務與重要任務是至關重要的。
collocations: draw a clear distinction（區分得非常清楚）

words.example_en: Do not leave sensitive company files exposed on unattended desks.
words.example_zh: 切勿將敏感的公司檔案暴露在無人看管的桌上。
collocations: exposed to risk（暴露於風險中）

words.definition: 集中的，密集的高強度的
words.example_en: New recruits undergo two weeks of intensive technical training.
words.example_zh: 新員工接受為期兩週的密集技術培訓。

words.example_en: Outdated software equipment proved problematic for daily operations.
words.example_zh: 過時的軟體設備被證明會給日常營運帶來問題。

words.example_en: The project coordinator managed communications between design and engineering.
words.example_zh: 專案協調員管理設計團隊與工程團隊之間的溝通。
collocations: senior project coordinator（高級專案協調員）

words.example_en: Effective project management software streamlines workflow and tracking.
words.example_zh: 有效的專案管理軟體能簡化工作流程與追蹤。
collocations: project management tool（專案管理工具）

words.example_en: The main auditorium has a seating capacity of five hundred people.
words.example_zh: 主禮堂的座位數可容納五百人。
collocations: maximum seating capacity（最大容納人數）

words.example_en: The administrative clerk will take care of catering for the workshop.
words.example_zh: 行政文員將負責處理研討會的外辦餐飲。
collocations: take care of an issue（處理問題）

words.example_en: She agreed to take on the role of team lead for the software project.
words.example_zh: 她同意接下軟體專案團隊領導者的角色。
collocations: take on new duties（接下新職責）

words.example_en: The new marketing strategy resulted in a tremendous surge in revenue.
words.example_zh: 新的行銷策略帶來了收入的巨大增長。

words.example_en: Under the new management, the company restructured its global divisions.
words.example_zh: 在新的經營團隊下，公司重組了其全球部門。
collocations: operate under the new management（在新管理層下營運）

words.example_en: An astute businessman recognized the investment opportunity early on.
words.example_zh: 一位精明的商人很早就辨識出了這項投資機會。

words.example_en: Please bring along your updated resume and identification badge.
words.example_zh: 請隨身攜帶最新的履歷表和識別證。

words.example_en: Store overhead luggage safely inside the airplane storage compartment.
words.example_zh: 將隨身行李安全地存放在飛機的頂頭置物櫃中。

words.example_en: Legacy mainframe systems will give way to cloud-based solutions.
words.example_zh: 傳統大型主機系統將讓位給基於雲端的解決方案。
collocations: give way to new technology（讓位給新技術）

words.example_en: Management introduced wellness programs to reduce employee overwork.
words.example_zh: 管理層推出了健康計畫以減少員工過勞。

words.example_en: Please put down your deposit to confirm your hotel reservation.
words.example_zh: 請付下您的訂金以確認您的飯店預訂。
collocations: put down a deposit（支付訂金）

words.example_en: After hours of negotiation, both sides finally reached the solution.
words.example_zh: 經過數小時的談判，雙方最終得出了解決方案。
collocations: reach a mutually beneficial solution（達成互利解決方案）

words.example_en: Taking a short break helps staff recharge their mental focus.
words.example_zh: 短暫休息有助於員工恢復精神與專注力。

words.example_en: Cleanroom technicians must wear a protective smock during assembly.
words.example_zh: 無塵室技術人員在組裝過程中必須穿著防護罩衫。

words.example_en: Cloud storage improves the accessibility of company documents worldwide.
words.example_zh: 雲端儲存提高了全球存取公司文件的便利性。

words.example_en: The event coordinator arranged all logistical details for the summit.
words.example_zh: 活動協調員安排了高峰會的所有後勤細節。

words.example_en: It is customary to exchange business cards when meeting clients in Asia.
words.example_zh: 在亞洲會見客戶時交換名片是慣常的禮儀。

words.example_en: A severe storm disrupted power supply across the manufacturing plant.
words.example_zh: 一場強烈的暴風雨打斷了整個製造工廠的電力供應。

words.example_en: The successful marketing campaign helped elevate brand awareness.
words.example_zh: 成功的行銷活動有助於提升品牌知名度。

words.example_en: Signing the paperwork is just a formality before starting your post.
words.example_zh: 在入職前，簽署文件只是一道正式手續。
collocations: mere formality（走過場的正式手續）

words.example_en: The manager exercised financial restraint during budget planning.
words.example_zh: 經理在預算規劃期間實施了財務克制與限制。

words.definition: 簽名登記外出；（電腦）登出
words.example_en: Please remember to sign out of the portal when you leave your desk.
words.example_zh: 離開座位時請記得登出系統入口。
collocations: sign out of system（登出系統）

words.example_en: The company's rapid sales growth is undeniable proof of product success.
words.example_zh: 公司銷售額的快速成長是產品成功的無可否認證明。

words.example_en: Disclosing trade secrets is a direct violation of company confidentiality.
words.example_zh: 洩露商業機密是對公司保密協議的直接違反。

words.example_en: Ignoring safety complaints will only aggravate employee dissatisfaction.
words.example_zh: 忽視安全投訴只會加劇員工的不滿。

words.example_en: The management set aside a contingency budget for unexpected expenses.
words.example_zh: 管理層預留了一筆預備金，以應對意外支出。

words.definition: 在～劃線，拒絕做～以上程度的事
words.example_en: We compromise on small terms, but we draw the line at unethical practices.
words.example_zh: 我們可以在小條款上妥協，但我們絕不接受不道德的做法（劃清界線）。
collocations: draw the line at unethical behavior（對不道德行為劃清界線）

words.example_en: The corporate lawyer was asked to draw up a formal lease contract.
words.example_zh: 公司律師被要求起草一份正式的租賃合約。
collocations: draw up a contract（起草合約）
draw up a proposal（起草提案）

words.example_en: When the fire alarm sounded, security officers helped evacuate the building.
words.example_zh: 當警報響起時，安衛人員協助撤離了大樓內部人員。

words.example_en: The company held a formal banquet in commemoration of its 20th anniversary.
words.example_zh: 公司舉辦了一場正式宴會以紀念創立 20 週年。
collocations: in commemoration of the anniversary（為了紀念週年）

words.example_en: New hires will remain on probation for the first three months of employment.
words.example_zh: 新員工在入職的前三個月將處於試用期。

words.example_en: It is dangerous to overestimate projected market demand during expansion.
words.example_zh: 在擴張期間高估預期的市場需求是危險的。

words.example_en: Executive parking spots are a privilege reserved for upper management.
words.example_zh: 高管停車位是專為高層管理人員保留的特別待遇。

words.example_en: The firm plans to restructure its operations to cut overhead costs.
words.example_zh: 該公司計劃改組其營運以降低日常開支成本。
collocations: restructure corporate debt（重組公司債務）

words.definition: 把 A 從 B 中分離出來
words.example_en: Recyclable materials should be segregated from regular office trash.
words.example_zh: 可回收材料應與普通辦公垃圾分開隔離。

words.definition: 觸發，引起 / 扳機；觸發器
words.example_en: A drop in quarterly sales could trigger an immediate internal policy review.
words.example_zh: 季度銷售下滑可能會引發立即的內部政策審查。

words.example_en: Investors are wary of committing capital during economic uncertainty.
words.example_zh: 在經濟不確定期間，投資者對投入資金持謹慎態度。
collocations: be wary of risks（對風險持謹慎態度）

description: 包含休假安排、旅遊住宿、餐飲聚會與商務社交活動相關詞彙

words.definition: 休息 / 休息；剩餘部分
words.example_en: After hours of negotiation, the representatives decided to rest before finalizing the deal.
words.example_zh: 經過數小時的談判，代表們決定在敲定交易前休息一下。

words.example_en: The gallery is hosting an international photography exhibition next month.
words.example_zh: 該畫廊下個月將舉辦一場國際攝影展。

words.example_en: The charity gala attracted several local celebrities and business leaders.
words.example_zh: 這場慈善晚會吸引了幾位當地名人和商業領袖。
collocations: local celebrity（知名人士/地方名人）

words.definition: 現場表演的；（廣播、電視）直播的 / 居住，生活
words.example_en: The corporate event featured a live music performance by a renowned jazz band.
words.example_zh: 該企業活動邀請了知名爵士樂團進行現場音樂表演。

words.definition: 即興演奏，即席演講，即興創作
words.example_en: When the projector failed, the speaker had to improvise his presentation.
words.example_zh: 當投影機故障時，講者不得不即興進行簡報。

words.example_en: The seaside resort is a popular destination for company retreats.
words.example_zh: 這座海濱度假勝地是企業員工旅遊的熱門去處。

words.example_en: The non-profit organization relies on corporate donations to fund its projects.
words.example_zh: 該非營利組織依靠企業捐款來資助其計畫。

words.example_en: Many distinguished alumni attended the university's annual fundraising banquet.
words.example_zh: 許多傑出校友參加了該大學的年度籌款宴會。

words.definition: 提出；出示 / 現在的；出席的 / 禮物
words.example_en: Applicants must present valid photo identification before entering the testing center.
words.example_zh: 應徵者在進入考場前必須出示有效的相片身分證明。
collocations: present A with B（贈送/提供 A 給 B）

words.example_en: General admission to the trade exhibition is free for pre-registered guests.
words.example_zh: 預先註冊的賓客可免費獲得貿易展覽的一般入場資格。

words.example_en: The annual awards banquet will be held in the grand ballroom of the hotel.
words.example_zh: 年度頒獎宴會將在飯店的宴會廳舉行。

words.example_en: The company hosted a special dinner to celebrate its 20th anniversary.
words.example_zh: 公司舉辦了一次特別晚餐以慶祝創立 20 週年。

words.example_en: Fluent communication in English is a required skill for this international role.
words.example_zh: 流利的英語溝通是該國際職位所需的必要技能。
collocations: be required to do（被要求去做……）

words.example_en: Ms. Lin will succeed Mr. Davis as the head of the marketing department.
words.example_zh: 林女士將接替戴維斯先生擔任行銷部主管。

words.definition: 收藏品，收集的東西；（款項的）收取
words.example_en: The museum boasts an extensive collection of modern Asian artwork.
words.example_zh: 該博物館擁有豐富的現代亞洲藝術收藏品。

words.example_en: The annual fund-raising campaign raised over $100,000 for local schools.
words.example_zh: 年度募款活動為當地學校籌集了十萬多美元。

words.example_en: The conference session will resume after a short fifteen-minute coffee break.
words.example_zh: 會議將在十五分鐘的咖啡茶敘休息後繼續進行。

words.definition: （期刊的）一期；問題，爭議 / 發行，發放
words.example_en: Articles on remote productivity were featured in the latest issue of the magazine.
words.example_zh: 最新一期雜誌專題報導了關於遠距工作生產力的文章。

words.example_en: You can renew your annual magazine subscription through our online portal.
words.example_zh: 您可以透過我們的線上網站續訂您的年度雜誌。

words.example_en: The keynote speaker will appear on stage shortly after the opening remarks.
words.example_zh: 主講嘉賓將在開幕致詞後不久現身台上。

words.example_en: All children under twelve must be accompanied by an adult inside the venue.
words.example_zh: 場館內十二歲以下兒童均須由成年人陪同。

words.example_en: The publisher released a revised edition of the business management textbook.
words.example_zh: 出版商推出了該企業管理教科書的修訂版。

words.example_en: The workshop was designed specifically for entry-level sales associates.
words.example_zh: 該工作坊是專門為初級銷售助理設計的。

words.example_en: The museum received a large donation from an anonymous benefactor.
words.example_zh: 該博物館收到了一筆來自匿名捐贈者的巨額捐款。

words.example_en: The corporation committed significant resources to community development.
words.example_zh: 該公司投入了大量資源用於社區發展。

words.example_en: Attendees found the seminar on digital marketing trends highly informative.
words.example_zh: 與會者認為關於數位行銷趨勢的研討會非常實用且資訊豐富。

words.example_en: The speaker engaged the audience with interactive polls during the talk.
words.example_zh: 講者在演講期間透過互動投票吸引了聽眾。
collocations: applause from audience（來自觀眾的掌聲）

words.example_en: The best-selling author held a book signing event at the central library.
words.example_zh: 這位暢銷作家在中央圖書館舉行了簽書會。

words.example_en: Please note that photography is strictly prohibited inside the exhibition room.
words.example_zh: 請注意，展覽室內嚴禁拍照。

words.example_en: The hotel lobby is decorated with valuable antique furniture.
words.example_zh: 飯店大廳飾有昂貴的古董家具。

words.example_en: The editor reviewed the author's complete manuscript before printing.
words.example_zh: 編輯在付印前審閱了作者的完整手稿。

words.example_en: Regular exercise and networking events are beneficial for staff well-being.
words.example_zh: 定期運動與社交活動對員工的身心健康有益。

words.example_en: Travelers are advised to keep valuable items inside their backpack.

words.example_zh: 許多員工選擇騎腳踏車上班以減少碳排放。

words.example_zh: 空服員在起飛前準備好了機艙。

words.example_zh: 公司員工旅遊包含了大家一起去爬山的選項。

words.example_zh: 他在湖邊度假村度過週末釣魚時光。

words.example_zh: 這家藝廊將展出當地新銳藝術家的作品。

words.example_zh: 我們收到了參加年度產業晚會的邀請。

words.example_zh: 宴會在飯店寬敞的前草坪上舉行。

words.example_zh: 維修工人給走廊牆壁塗上了油漆。

words.example_zh: 一幅昂貴的油畫在慈善活動中被拍賣競標。

words.example_zh: 賓客們晚上聚集在休息室玩撲克牌。

words.example_en: The public library offers free digital access to educational databases.
words.example_zh: 公共圖書館提供免費的教育資料庫數位存取服務。

words.example_zh: 公司贊助了一項募款水資源的慈善馬拉松賽跑。

words.example_zh: 執行董事會在一家海灘度假村舉行了年度戰略共識營。

words.example_zh: 市中心戲院新劇的門票很快就售罄了。

words.example_zh: 完成商業會議後，我們決定去看一部電影。

words.example_en: The travel package includes outdoor hiking adventures for tourists.
words.example_zh: 該旅遊套裝包含專為遊客設計的戶外健行冒險行程。
collocations: sense of adventure（冒險精神/冒險感）

words.example_en: The modern art museum features sculptures from world-renowned artists.
words.example_zh: 這家現代美術館展出了世界知名藝術家的雕塑作品。
collocations: visit an art museum（參觀美術館）

words.example_en: The opening ceremony will begin promptly at nine in the morning.
words.example_zh: 開幕典禮將於早晨九點準時開始。

words.example_en: Please bring your ID pass to gain entry to the exhibition hall.
words.example_zh: 請攜帶您的識別證進場參觀展覽廳。

words.example_en: The hotel staff is dedicated to caring for every guest's individual needs.
words.example_zh: 飯店員工致力於照料每一位賓客的個人需求。
collocations: care for guests（照顧顧客需求）

words.example_en: The company bought tickets to the symphony concert for its partners.
words.example_zh: 公司購買了交響音樂會的門票送給其合作夥伴。

words.example_en: The entire length of the film presentation is forty-five minutes.
words.example_zh: 影片展示的全長為四十五分鐘。
collocations: length of stay（住宿天數/停留時間）

words.example_en: The hotel provides various leisure facilities including a pool and gym.
words.example_zh: 飯店提供各種休閒設施，包括游泳池和健身房。

words.example_en: The librarian assisted researchers in locating historical archives.
words.example_zh: 圖書館館員協助研究人員尋找歷史檔案。

words.example_en: The catering service updated its menu options for corporate events.
words.example_zh: 外辦餐飲服務更新了其企業活動的菜單品項。

words.example_en: A guided sightseeing tour was organized for international delegates.
words.example_zh: 為國際代表們組織了一次配有導覽的觀光行程。

words.example_en: The company sponsored an outing to an amusement park for employees and families.
words.example_zh: 公司贊助了員工及其家屬前往遊樂園的郊遊活動。
collocations: visit an amusement park（前往遊樂園）

words.example_en: The museum exhibits rare artifacts related to ancient history.
words.example_zh: 博物館展出了與古代歷史相關的珍貴文物。
collocations: study ancient history（研究古代歷史）

words.example_en: Historical artifacts are displayed securely in glass cases.
words.example_zh: 歷史文物被妥善地展示在玻璃櫃中。

words.example_en: The keynote address will take place in the central auditorium.
words.example_zh: 主旨演講將在中央禮堂舉行。

words.example_en: All hotel rooms are completely booked up during the festival week.
words.example_zh: 節慶盛會那一週，所有飯店房間都被預訂一空。
collocations: fully booked up（全部被預約滿）

words.example_en: You can pick up pre-ordered concert tickets at the box office.
words.example_zh: 您可以在售票處領取預訂的音樂會門票。

words.example_en: The receptionist greeted visitors with a cheerful smile.
words.example_zh: 接待員以愉快的微笑迎接收接訪客。

words.example_en: The corporate choir performed festive songs at the year-end party.
words.example_zh: 公司合唱團在年終聚會上演唱了節慶歌曲。

words.example_en: The firm booked a private dining suite to entertain VIP clients.
words.example_zh: 該公司預訂了包廂套餐宴會廳以款待貴賓客戶。

words.example_en: Beautiful flower arrangements decorated each banquet table.
words.example_zh: 美麗的插花作品點綴著每一張宴會桌。

words.example_en: Groundskeepers maintain the colorful flower beds surrounding the resort.
words.example_zh: 園丁維護著度假村四周色彩繽紛的花圃。

words.example_en: They decided to go to a film after finishing dinner downtown.
words.example_zh: 吃完市中心的晚餐後，他們決定去看電影。
collocations: go to a film together（一起去看電影）

words.example_en: Make sure to grip the paddle firmly while kayaking in current.
words.example_zh: 在水流中划獨木舟時，務必緊握槳。
collocations: get a grip on（控制/掌握）

words.example_en: Many residents jog along the street early in the morning.
words.example_zh: 許多居民清晨沿著街道慢跑。
collocations: jog along the street for exercise（沿街慢跑鍛鍊）

words.example_en: Musicians tuned their musical instruments before the concert started.
words.example_zh: 音樂家們在音樂會開始前調校了他們的樂器。
collocations: play a musical instrument（演奏樂器）

words.example_en: Each rowing boat is equipped with a pair of wooden oars.
words.example_zh: 每艘划艇都配有一對木槳。

words.example_en: An 18th-century oil painting is the highlight of the current exhibition.
words.example_zh: 一幅 18 世紀的油畫是本次展覽的亮點。
collocations: exhibit an oil painting（展出油畫）

words.example_en: The hotel features a large outdoor swimming pool and terrace.
words.example_zh: 該飯店擁有大型戶外游泳池和露台。

words.definition: 用槳划船；用手腳划水 / 槳
words.example_en: Tourists used lightweight plastic paddles to navigate the river.
words.example_zh: 遊客們使用輕便的塑膠槳在河流中划行。

words.example_en: Celebrities attended the movie premiere at the central cinema.
words.example_zh: 名人出席了在中央影城舉行的電影首映會。

words.example_en: Groundskeeping staff work daily to rake leaves off the golf course.
words.example_zh: 園藝維護人員每天清掃高爾夫球場上的落葉。
collocations: rake autumn leaves（清掃秋天落葉）

words.example_en: The resort offers a variety of recreational activities for guests.
words.example_zh: 該度假村為賓客提供各種娛樂活動。

words.example_en: Members reserve the right to access private lounge facilities.

words.example_zh: 這部紀錄片的總片長為九十分鐘。

words.example_en: During the company trip, executives went out to sail a boat along the coast.
words.example_zh: 在公司旅遊期間，高管們沿著海岸出海駕帆船。
collocations: sail a boat along coast（沿海岸駕駛帆船）

words.example_en: Children enjoyed playing as they slid down the water slide at the park.
words.example_zh: 孩子們在水上樂園順著滑水道滑下去，玩得很開心。
collocations: slide down the slope（順著斜坡滑下）

words.example_en: Swimmers splashed water as they entered the pool for the race.
words.example_zh: 游泳選手進入泳池準備比賽時濺起水花。
collocations: make a splash（引起轟動/濺起水花）

words.example_en: The annual sports tournament brings together branches from across the region.
words.example_zh: 年度體育錦標賽匯集了來自全區的分公司代表。
collocations: annual sports tournament（年度體育賽事）

words.example_en: Thousands of spectators packed into the city stadium for the championship game.
words.example_zh: 數千名觀眾湧入市立體育場觀看冠軍賽。

words.example_en: Students often stay up late revising for certification exams.
words.example_zh: 學生們經常熬夜溫習認證考試。

words.example_en: Guests can stroll through the hotel's botanic garden after dinner.
words.example_zh: 賓客可以在晚餐後在飯店的植物園漫步散步。
collocations: stroll along the beach（沿海灘散步）

words.example_en: Let's take a ten-minute break before moving to the next agenda item.
words.example_zh: 在進入下一個議程項目之前，我們休息十分鐘吧。
collocations: take a short break（休息一下）

words.example_en: He usually takes his dog for a walk in the public park after work.
words.example_zh: 他通常下班後帶他的狗去公園散步。
collocations: take the dog for a walk（帶狗去散步）

words.example_en: Visitors are permitted to take photographs in the museum courtyard.
words.example_zh: 允許訪客在博物館中庭拍照。

words.example_en: Taking a walk during lunch hours helps employees clear their minds.
words.example_zh: 午休時間散步有助於員工清醒頭腦。

words.example_zh: 我們非常樂意邀請您參加我們的年度企業宴會。

words.example_en: The graphic designer will touch up the photograph before printing the magazine.
words.example_zh: 平面設計師會在付印雜誌前修飾這張照片。

words.example_zh: 旅行社推出了前往夏威夷的實惠度假套裝方案。

words.example_en: Diners had to wait for seats outside the popular restaurant.
words.example_zh: 用餐者不得不在这家熱門餐廳外等候座位。

words.example_en: Concertgoers were willing to wait in line for hours to buy merchandise.
words.example_zh: 演唱會觀眾願意排隊等候數小時購買周邊商品。
collocations: wait in line for tickets（排隊買票）

words.example_en: Office assistants are responsible for watering the plants in the lobby.
words.example_zh: 辦公室助理負責為大廳裡的植物澆水。

words.example_en: The comedian's performance managed to amuse the entire audience.
words.example_zh: 喜劇演員的表演逗樂了全場觀眾。

words.example_en: She combines strong technical skills with exceptional artistic talent.
words.example_zh: 她將強大的技術能力與卓越的藝術天賦相結合。

words.example_en: Local businesses were encouraged to donate funds to the community center.
words.example_zh: 鼓勵當地企業向社區中心捐贈資金。

words.example_zh: 雖然下著雨，戶外節慶活動還是按計畫進行。
collocations: even though rain falls（即使下雨）

words.example_en: The museum will exhibit historical photography from the 19th century.
words.example_zh: 博物館將展出 19 世紀的歷史攝影作品。

words.example_zh: 科學中心在週二向學童提供免費入場。

words.example_en: The host invited guests to relax and make themselves at home.
words.example_zh: 主人邀請賓客們放鬆，把這裡當自己家一樣。

words.example_zh: 市議會批准了市立公園翻修計畫的資金。

words.example_zh: 財務辦公室發送了一份關於客戶所欠金額的通知。

words.example_en: Several corporate sponsors contributed to the fundraising event.
words.example_zh: 幾家企業贊助商為募款活動做出了貢獻。

words.example_en: Thousands of spectators cheered as the runner crossed the finish line.
words.example_zh: 當跑者跨過終點線時，數千名觀眾歡呼雀躍。

words.example_en: The usher guided latecomers to their seats quietly during the performance.
words.example_zh: 演出期間，引導員安靜地引導晚到者入座。

words.example_en: Her innovative design helped her win a contest sponsored by the tech firm.
words.example_zh: 她的創新設計幫助她在這家科技公司贊助的競賽中獲勝。

words.example_zh: 您的門票賦予直接進入所有展覽廳的資格。

words.example_zh: 每位參賽者都向評審團展示了他們的商業模式。

words.example_en: It was a pure delight to host the international delegation at our hotel.
words.example_zh: 在我們的飯店招待國際代表團純粹是一件令人愉快的事。

words.example_zh: 她在頒獎典禮前預約了美髮沙龍做髮型。
collocations: do one's hair for gala（為晚會用髮型）

words.example_en: The evening dinner party provided an enjoyable networking opportunity.
words.example_zh: 晚間餐會提供了一個令人愉快的社交交流機會。

words.example_en: The museum offers a discounted group rate for parties of ten or more.
words.example_zh: 博物館為十人或十人以上的團體提供優惠的團體價。

words.example_zh: 會議結束後，與會者將前往接待大廳。

words.example_en: The ticket vending machine is temporarily out of order.
words.example_zh: 自動售票機暫時故障了。

words.example_en: The company library subscribes to major industry trade periodicals.
words.example_zh: 公司圖書館訂閱了主要的產業貿易期刊。

words.example_en: Fair regulations create a level playing field for all competing businesses.
words.example_zh: 公平的法規為所有競爭企業創造了一個公平競爭的環境（場地）。

words.example_en: Please register for the workshop online before seat capacity is reached.
words.example_zh: 請在額滿前上網報名參加工作坊。

words.example_zh: 三百多人出席了慈善音樂會之夜。

words.example_en: Visitors were invited to take a tour of the historical winery.
words.example_zh: 訪客獲邀參觀這座歷史悠久的酒莊。

words.example_zh: 數十名粉絲正排隊等待進入禮堂。

words.example_zh: 我們今天為什麼不把團隊會議改在戶外舉行，換換口味呢？

words.example_en: Passengers read magazines to pass the time during the long flight.
words.example_zh: 乘客們在長途飛行中閱讀雜誌以消磨時間。

words.example_en: The athletes posed for photos after receiving their medals.
words.example_zh: 運動員們在領取獎牌後擺出姿勢拍照。
collocations: pose for a photo（擺姿勢拍照）

words.example_en: Stay tuned for more live updates on the championship tournament.
words.example_zh: 請保持鎖定，以獲取錦標賽的更多現場即時報導。
collocations: stay tuned for updates（關注最新動態）

words.example_en: Guests must vacate their hotel rooms by 11:00 AM on checkout day.
words.example_zh: 賓客必須在退房當天上午 11:00 前空出房間。
collocations: vacate the premises（騰出/撤離場所）
vacate a room（退房/空出房間）

words.example_en: The organization is deeply appreciative of all sponsor contributions.
words.example_zh: 該機構對所有贊助商的貢獻深表感謝。

words.definition: （服裝）休閒地，非正式地；隨便地

words.example_zh: 員工們穿著休閒裝參加週五晚上的社交聚會。

words.example_en: The guest speaker delivered an enlightening presentation on cultural trends.
words.example_zh: 客座主講人發表了一場關於文化趨勢、富有啟發性的簡報。

words.example_en: The audience enthusiastically applauded the pianist's solo performance.
words.example_zh: 觀眾對鋼琴家的獨奏表演熱情地鼓掌。

words.example_en: The resort was recognized with an award for excellence in customer service.
words.example_zh: 該度假村榮獲客戶服務卓越獎。

words.example_en: The cruise price includes a guided day excursion to historical ruins.
words.example_zh: 郵輪價格包含前往歷史遺跡的導覽一日短途旅行。

words.example_en: Holiday festivities will begin with a parade through the main city square.
words.example_zh: 節慶慶祝活動將以穿過主城市廣場的遊行揭開序幕。

words.definition: 聚集，群集 / 一群（人、羊、鳥等）

words.example_zh: 暑假期間，遊客成群結隊地湧向這座沿海小鎮。

words.example_en: The art exhibition was intriguingly arranged by historical themes.
words.example_zh: 這場藝術展引人好奇地按歷史主題進行了佈置。

words.definition: （在交通工具內）腿部能伸展的空間

words.example_zh: 商務艙乘客在長途航班上享有額外的伸腿空間。

words.example_en: A vibrant public mural was painted on the side of the community center.
words.example_zh: 社區中心側牆上繪製了一幅色彩鮮豔的公共壁畫。

words.example_en: The museum acquired an authentic portrait of the historical leader.
words.example_zh: 該博物館獲得了一幅這位歷史領袖的真實肖像畫。
collocations: family portrait（家庭合照/全家福肖像）

words.example_en: The latest publication from the research institute features global market analysis.
words.example_zh: 該研究所的最新出版品專題報導了全球市場分析。

words.example_en: Bronze sculptures were installed along the hotel's garden path.
words.example_zh: 青銅雕塑品安裝在飯店的花園小徑旁。

words.example_en: Concert tickets are non-transferable and must be used by the buyer.
words.example_zh: 演唱會門票不可轉讓，必須由購買者本人使用。

words.example_en: The health inspector shut down the food stall due to unsanitary conditions.
words.example_zh: 衛生檢查員因衛生條件不合格而關閉了該食品攤位。

words.example_en: After a busy work week, she was in the mood for watching a movie.
words.example_zh: 忙碌了一週工作後，她有看電影的心情。
collocations: be in the mood for relaxation（有放鬆的心情）

words.example_en: The local botanical garden features thousands of exotic plant species.
words.example_zh: 當地的植物園擁有數千種珍稀植物品種。
collocations: visit the botanical garden（造訪植物園）

words.definition: （對媒體、出版品等的）審查制度
words.example_en: The media outlet complies strictly with local publication censorship regulations.
words.example_zh: 該媒體機構嚴格遵守當地出版審查法規。

words.example_en: Organizers have yet to announce the finalized lineup for the music festival.
words.example_zh: 主辦單位尚未公布音樂節的最終演出陣容。
collocations: have yet to confirm（尚未確認）

words.definition: （音樂會、舞台表演中途的）休息時間
words.example_en: Refreshments were served in the foyer during the twenty-minute intermission.
words.example_zh: 在二十分鐘的中場休息時間裡，休息區提供了茶點。
collocations: twenty-minute intermission（二十分鐘的中場休息）

words.example_en: The retired executive published his personal memoirs about corporate leadership.
words.example_zh: 這位退休高管出版了關於企業領導力的個人回憶錄。

words.definition: 一定要看的東西 / 景點
words.example_en: The historical museum exhibition is widely considered a must-see in the city.
words.example_zh: 歷史博物館展覽被廣泛認為是該市必看的景點。

words.example_en: Spectators lined the track to watch the annual motor rally.
words.example_zh: 觀眾在賽道旁排隊觀看年度汽車拉力賽。

words.example_en: Ticket scalpers were selling concert passes at a ridiculous price.
words.example_zh: 黃牛正以荒謬離譜的價格販售演唱會門票。

words.example_en: Tourists like to roam around the historic old town after dinner.
words.example_zh: 遊客們喜歡在晚餐後在歷史悠久的老城區四處閒逛。
collocations: roam around the streets（在街上閒逛）
